jobs.title: Underwriting Support Specialist
jobs.description:
About the team
As an Underwriting Support Specialist within Zillow Home Loans, you’ll join a growing India-based mortgage operations team focused on delivering accurate, timely, and scalable support across the underwriting lifecycle.
The team partners with U.S. Underwriters and cross-functional mortgage operations teams to complete defined review, documentation, validation, and workflow activities. As the business evolves, the team’s scope may expand into additional underwriting-support functions that improve quality, reduce operational friction, and help loans progress efficiently.
Zillow Group is a strategic, mission-driven organization focused on delivering exceptional experiences and measurable outcomes. Our work spans cross-functional partnership, scalable programs and operational excellence in support of Zillow’s mission. We bring deep experience working across diverse teams in a dynamic, high-growth environment, balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution to drive meaningful business impact. We are seeking an experienced professional to support our workforce expansion in India.
About the role
As an Underwriting Support Specialist, you will support mortgage underwriting operations by reviewing loan-file information, validating documentation and data, managing assigned workflow activities, and identifying items that require further action or escalation. You will apply established procedures and checklists, maintain clear and accurate documentation, and collaborate with partners to resolve issues within your assigned authority.
You Will Get To
Complete assigned underwriting-support reviews and operational activities in accordance with established policies, procedures, quality standards, and service-level expectations.
Review loan-file documentation, system data, and supporting information for completeness, accuracy, consistency, and required follow-up..
Resolve routine issues within assigned authority and promptly escalate complex, high-risk, out-of-policy, or time-sensitive matters to the appropriate Underwriter, manager, or functional partner.
Update relevant systems, queues, trackers, and loan-file records to ensure work is accurately reflected and progresses through the applicable workflow.
Manage work in assigned queues and prioritize tasks based on established service levels, loan urgency, customer commitments, and business priorities.
Partner with Underwriting, Processing, Closing, Quality Control, Credit Specialists, and other mortgage operations teams to resolve issues and improve handoffs.
Participate in quality reviews, coaching, calibration, and training; apply feedback to improve accuracy, consistency, judgment, and turnaround time.
Surface recurring defects, process gaps, and opportunities to improve SOPs, checklists, tools, and operating controls.
Adapt to evolving processes, systems, products, and work assignments as the Underwriting Support function grows.
Maintain the confidentiality and privacy of borrower, customer, and employee information at all times.
This role has been categorized as an Office position. “Office” employees regularly work at the Zillow India office for approximately 80 to 100 percent of their time each month. Employees must live within a reasonable commuting distance of the office. Zillow has not defined a reasonable distance, and expects employees will use judgment in determining this for themselves and understand the implications re: time commitment and cost of daily commute.
Who you are
You have 2+ years of experience in U.S. residential mortgage underwriting, quality control, loan processing, closing, post-closing, credit review, fraud review, or a related mortgage operations function.
Familiarity with Encompass or comparable mortgage workflow and knowledge-management tools.
You understand core residential mortgage loan documentation, systems, and workflows.
You are detail-oriented and can identify inconsistencies, missing information, risk indicators, and issues that require escalation.
You have strong analytical judgment and are comfortable applying SOPs, checklists, and defined escalation paths.
You are organized, able to manage competing priorities, and successful in a high-volume, deadline-driven environment.
You have strong written, and verbal communication skills.
You collaborate effectively with distributed teams across functions and time zones.
You are proficient with Google Workspace or Microsoft Office, Tableau and Highspot are preferable.
You are comfortable working in an office-based night-shift schedule aligned to U.S. business operations, as required.
Get to know us
At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality.
Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2026, and included on TIME’s America’s Best Companies 2026 list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.
No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.

As an Underwriting Support Manager, you will lead, coach, and develop a team of Underwriting Support Specialists, ensuring consistent execution of assigned activities in accordance with established policies, procedures, quality standards, and service-level expectations.
You will own people leadership, day-to-day team operations, workload and capacity management, quality oversight, performance management, and continuous improvement across assigned underwriting-support activities. You’ll design and refine workflows, implement quality controls, and use data to drive performance across quality, speed, and partner experience. You will partner closely with U.S. Underwriting leaders and other mortgage operations teams to resolve escalations, strengthen handoffs, and build scalable processes as the function grows.
This role leads underwriting-support execution within defined authority and escalation paths; it does not independently assume final underwriting approval or credit-exception authority.
Zillow Group is a strategic, mission-driven organization focused on delivering exceptional experiences and measurable outcomes. Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of Underwriting Support Specialists, setting clear expectations and fostering accountability, sound judgment, collaboration, and professional growth.
Own daily team operations, including queue management, workload allocation, staffing coverage, and prioritization based on service levels, loan urgency, customer commitments, and business priorities.
Oversee assigned loan-file reviews, documentation and data validation, and workflow activities to ensure accurate, complete, consistent, and timely execution.
Monitor team performance through measures such as turnaround time, service-level adherence, productivity, backlog aging, defect rates, and rework; use insights to address gaps and improve results.

You are a strong people leader who sets clear expectations, builds trust, provides effective coaching, and develops individual contributors.
You have experience managing high-volume operations, balancing team capacity, and delivering against quality, productivity, and service-level expectations.
You can use operational metrics and quality findings to identify trends, investigate root causes, and implement measurable improvements.
You demonstrate sound analytical judgment and can identify documentation inconsistencies, missing information, risk indicators, and matters requiring escalation.
You communicate clearly in writing and verbally, translating operational issues into concise, actionable updates for team members and cross-functional partners.
You collaborate effectively with distributed teams across functions and time zones and are comfortable leading through change and ambiguity.
You are familiar with Encompass or comparable mortgage workflow systems and proficient with Google Workspace or Microsoft Office.
You are comfortable working an office-based night-shift schedule aligned to U.S. business operations, as required.

Experience leading underwriting-support, mortgage quality-control, or related fulfillment teams supporting U.S. Underwriters.

jobs.title: Senior Benefits Analyst
jobs.description:
About the team
The Senior Benefits Analyst will be an integral operational partner to the U.S.-based Benefits Team. Based in India, this role supports the accurate, compliant, and efficient delivery of our benefits programs — from day-to-day administration and employee support to data integrity, compliance, and reporting.
You will also partner closely with the Benefits Program Managers to support benefits administration across our locations- U.S, Mexico, India, Germany, Canada, and Serbia. This is a high-impact, high-visibility role within our GCC and an opportunity to grow deep expertise in global benefits operations.
Zillow Group is a strategic, mission-driven organization focused on delivering exceptional experiences and measurable outcomes. Our work spans cross-functional partnership, scalable programs and operational excellence in support of Zillow’s mission. We bring deep experience working across diverse teams in a dynamic, high-growth environment, balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution to drive meaningful business impact. We are seeking an experienced professional to support our workforce expansion in India.
About the role
Benefits Administration
Administer employee benefits programs across health, welfare, retirement, and ancillary plans, ensuring accuracy and a positive employee experience.
Process enrollment transactions, qualifying life events, and employee data changes in the HRIS; partner with carriers and vendors to resolve discrepancies.
Serve as a Tier 3 resource for employee benefits inquiries, providing clear and timely guidance on plan provisions, eligibility, and enrollment processes.
Assist with benefits billing processes, including data validation and submission support; U.S. team retains payment authorization.
Partner with the Global Benefits Program Manager to support international benefits administration across multiple countries, including enrollment coordination, billing reconciliation, and carrier data management.
Support routine plan administration tasks for international programs, including data pulls, eligibility tracking, and audit support.
Compliance & Audit
Support the preparation and coordination of recurring U.S. benefits compliance obligations, including annual filings, regulatory reporting, and plan documentation.
Execute a portfolio of recurring data audits across benefit programs to ensure enrollment accuracy, eligibility integrity, and data quality.
Prepare audit documentation, organize supporting materials, and manage audit checklists; escalate findings and flag discrepancies to the U.S. team for resolution.
Monitor ongoing compliance obligations and proactively surface issues to the appropriate U.S. owner.
This role has been categorized as an Office position. “Office” employees regularly work at the Zillow India office for approximately 80 to 100 percent of their time each month. Employees must live within a reasonable commuting distance of the office. Zillow has not defined a reasonable distance, and expects employees will use judgment in determining this for themselves and understand the implications re: time commitment and cost of daily commute.
In addition to a competitive base pay, employees in this role are eligible for incentive compensation subject to applicable laws and relevant Zillow policies. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location.
Who you are
Detail-oriented and process-driven. You take ownership of complex, multi-step processes and execute them with precision and consistency.
Proactive and accountable. You identify issues before they become problems, escalate clearly with documented findings, and follow through to resolution.
Collaborative. You work seamlessly across time zones, building trust with U.S. counterparts through reliable communication and dependable follow-through.
Analytically minded. You’re comfortable working with data across HRIS and vendor platforms — pulling reports, spotting anomalies, and organizing findings clearly.
Effective in Cloud HQ. You thrive in a remote, asynchronous environment, communicate clearly in writing, and build trust without in-person presence.
Curious about the ‘why’. You want to understand the context behind the work, not just complete tasks — and you ask questions when something doesn’t add up.
Qualifications
4+ years of experience in benefits administration, HR operations, or a related field
Experience administering health, welfare, and/or retirement benefit programs
Familiarity with benefits compliance concepts and regulatory obligations is a strong plus
Experience supporting global or international benefits programs preferred
Proficiency with Workday or a comparable HRIS; comfortable running reports and processing benefit transactions
Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills for data reconciliation and reporting
Excellent written communication skills in English; able to communicate clearly with employees, vendors, and global counterparts
Comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced, asynchronous, remote environment
Get to know us
At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers.
As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., Zillow helps millions of customers navigate buying, selling, financing, and renting with greater ease and confidence. Our teams in India play a critical role in building and scaling the technology, products, and operations that power this experience.
Whether you’re working in tech, operations, or shared services, you’ll collaborate with global partners to solve meaningful problems and help more people make home a reality.

Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2025, and included on the PEOPLE Companies That Care® 2025 list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.
No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.

jobs.title: Director, Engineering
jobs.description:
About the team
Zillow's Enterprise Platforms & Technology (EP&T) organization runs the third-party SaaS platforms that power our business: Workday, ServiceNow, Salesforce, and the AI infrastructure that increasingly mediates how Zillow employees experience these systems. Workday powers our HR and Finance operations. ServiceNow runs IT and HR service delivery. The agentic AI layer we're building on top of these platforms is reshaping how employees get help, complete tasks, and navigate their work day.
We are building a new India-based engineering team to take end-to-end ownership of Workday HR and ServiceNow in 2026, with potential expansion to other enterprise SaaS platforms in the future. This team will own its platform stacks completely — production access, change ownership, on-call rotation, direct stakeholder relationships — not as remote staffing for US-led work, but as a peer engineering organization with its own architectural authority.
EP&T operates with an AI-native engineering culture. Modern AI coding and agent tooling is baseline practice across our existing US teams. For your India team, that means AI-augmented configuration is the daily reality: designing Workday business processes, generating ServiceNow flows, and writing platform-bounded code with AI as a partner, at a pace that traditional methods can't match. Your team's success proves and scales this operating model.
This is a team where your technical credibility matters. We are building it from scratch, and the leader who joins now will lay the engineering foundation for Zillow's enterprise-wide shift to invisible, agent-mediated platforms, and define what excellence looks like in this space for years to come.
Zillow Group is a strategic, mission-driven organization focused on delivering exceptional experiences and measurable outcomes. Our work spans cross-functional partnership, scalable programs and operational excellence in support of Zillow’s mission. We bring deep experience working across diverse teams in a dynamic, high-growth environment, balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution to drive meaningful business impact. We are seeking an experienced professional to support our workforce expansion in India.
About the role
As Director of Engineering for Enterprise SaaS Platforms (India), you’ll build Zillow's India platform engineering organization from the ground up.
You will report directly to the global leader of Enterprise Platforms & Technology and be one of the first engineering directors based in India. As the sole engineering director in EP&T based in India, you'll partner with your US-based peer leaders in Engineering, Product, and Design, but will have broad latitude to shape culture, hiring practices, and operating norms for the team you build.
You will personally recruit the senior bench, allowing you to pull talent from your network. You will hold the bar on AI-native engineering practices, partner closely with US-based domain experts and product managers to translate design intent into production reality, and work with Zillow's US-based platform and agentic engineering team to deliver the integration and AI infrastructure that connects your work into the broader enterprise.
Responsibilities:
Build the team
Recruit, hire, and develop an India engineering team and management team
Recruit your senior bench, leveraging your network and your reputation to bring in the talent you need to deliver our vision
Coach the next layer of India leadership — managers and senior engineers who will be key to the success of your organization
Represent Zillow's India engineering presence externally; recruit actively from the Workday and ServiceNow ecosystems
Own the Workday platform
Drive end-to-end Workday HR delivery: business process configuration, EIB integrations, scripted custom logic, security model, reporting, and production operations
Own and execute SOX-compliant change management across Workday in partnership with Zillow's People, Finance, and Audit organizations
Champion AI-augmented configuration patterns as the productivity multiplier on platform engineering and configuration work
Directly manage the Workday team and partner with the US-based platform and agentic engineering team on MCP integration and agent capabilities
Own the ServiceNow platform
Drive end-to-end ServiceNow delivery: HR Service Delivery, IT Service Management, scoped applications, scripted REST endpoints, Integration Hub flows
Directly manage the ServiceNow team and partner with the US-based platform and agentic engineering team on MCP integration and agent capabilities
Establish operating norms
Set the operating cadence with US-based domain experts, product managers, and platform engineering peers, maintaining end-to-end ownership and a tight feedback loop between US-based stakeholders, design partners, and engineering build teams.
Build an engineering culture where AI is the engine of daily work: your team uses AI tooling to design and validate Workday business processes, generate ServiceNow flows, write and review platform-bounded code, and automate documentation and change evidence faster than traditional methods allow
Set multi-year strategic direction for India's platform scope, tightly coupled to Zillow's broader business and AI roadmap
Own budget, planning, vendor relationships, tooling, and talent decisions for the India organization
Partner across Zillow
Engage as a peer technical voice with Zillow's HR business partners, IT customers, and engineering leadership
Represent the India team in EP&T leadership rituals — staff meetings, planning, monthly business reviews
Bridge time zones, cultures, and operating styles so the US-India model works as a single distributed engineering org

Employees must live within a reasonable commuting distance of the office. Who you are
We are looking for a builder, a leader, and a talent magnet. You bring:
Team builder and talent magnet: you've built engineering teams from scratch. You recruit senior engineers from your network and selectively from outside, develop them into top performers, and set culture and operating norms early to grow a high-performing team from a blank page.
AI-native posture: you actively use modern AI coding and agent tooling in your own work, and you have championed AI-tooling adoption in teams you've led. You're not someone who's "open to AI", you're already practicing it.

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager, Software Engineering
jobs.description:
About the team
The Developer Experience (DevEx) Delivery Engineering team builds and operates Zillow's software delivery platform. This is the paved road from commit to production that every Zillow Group engineer relies on to build, test, deploy, and ship. The platform supports org-wide delivery infrastructure at meaningful scale: CI/CD, runners, GitLab, Artifactory, Progressive Delivery, mobile build and release, and legacy migration programs. We are shifting from hands-on infrastructure operations toward secure, compliant, AI-first paved paths that improve reliability, release safety, and developer productivity.

jobs.description:
About the team
Zillow's People Technology organization builds and operates the platforms that power how Zillow employees work: Workday, ServiceNow, and the agentic AI layer connecting these systems to the surfaces employees use every day - Slack, Google Workspace, Zoom, and AI tools. The India engineering team owns this platform stack end to end: production access, change ownership, on-call rotation, and direct relationships with the business teams we support.

Zillow Group is a strategic, mission-driven organization focused on delivering exceptional experiences and measurable outcomes. Our work spans cross-functional partnership, scalable programs and operational excellence in support of Zillow’s mission. We bring deep experience working across diverse teams in a dynamic, high-growth environment, balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution to drive meaningful business impact. We are seeking an experienced professional to support our workforce expansion in India.
About the role
As Sr. Technical Program Manager, you are the connective tissue of the PeopleTech delivery model. You own the sprint cadence, the handoff quality gate between Product and Engineering, and the cross-team coordination that keeps India-based engineering and US-based product and business partners in sync. You are a single, senior individual contributor - not a team of TPMs - which means you need to be decisive, organized, and confident operating across time zones without a lot of structural backup.
You will work directly with the Product Managers (US-based) and the India Engineering team, and will be a key voice in how the model matures over time. This is a high-visibility role in a new operating model that is still being built; you will help define how it works, not just execute inside it.
Responsibilities
Own sprint execution end to end: create and close sprints in Jira, run grooming and planning, lead standup, track capacity and velocity, and ensure all stories are estimated and complete before each sprint closes.
Serve as the handoff quality gate between Product and Engineering: review stories for build readiness before sprint commitment, flag ambiguity or missing technical context, and resolve open requirements questions in partnership with PM and Engineering before work begins.
Own the US-India coordination bridge: run a daily touchpoint with the PM to carry blocker and handoff status, facilitate the overlap-window ceremonies (grooming, sprint planning, sprint demo) where PM and Engineering both need to be present, and maintain async-first practices that keep live meeting load low.
Manage cross-team dependencies and risks: identify sequencing issues and resource constraints early, route blockers to the right owner (Engineering or PM), and escalate to leadership when something threatens delivery.
Coordinate Unit Test logistics: manage test resources, defect tracking, and the communication between Engineering and the PM during unit testing cycles.
Document the team's operational model: post-launch on-call and support structure, escalation paths, and the handoff from project delivery into business-as-usual operations.
Drive continuous improvement: use retrospective findings to sharpen handoff processes, story quality, and sprint predictability over time; build and share repeatable practices that improve how the team works.
Apply AI tools to program work: status synthesis, risk and dependency tracking, meeting notes and follow-ups, draft communications - and help the broader team build that fluency.
This role has been categorized as an Office position. “Office” employees regularly work at the Zillow India office for approximately 80 to 100 percent of their time each month. Employees must live within a reasonable commuting distance of the office. Zillow has not defined a reasonable distance, and expects employees will use judgment in determining this for themselves and understand the implications re: time commitment and cost of daily commute.
Who you are
5-8 years of technical program or project/scrum team management experience delivering complex, cross-functional programs in enterprise SaaS or platform environments.
Demonstrated ownership of programs spanning multiple teams end to end, including programs where you defined scope and goals yourself in ambiguous conditions.
Strong technical fluency: you can understand and explain how Workday, ServiceNow, or comparable enterprise platforms fit together, reason about integration dependencies, and assess whether a user story is ready to build - without needing to write the code yourself.
Demonstrated working knowledge of Workday HCM or ServiceNow (module configuration, integrations, annual HR cycles, security model basics).
Experience operating in a distributed or offshore/nearshore engineering model, with US-based product and business partners - you understand how to design for async-first collaboration and how to use overlap hours well.
Best-in-class Jira and sprint management skills: you run ceremonies cleanly, keep the board accurate, and produce sprint summaries that give leadership a clear picture without requiring a meeting.
Strong communication across technical and non-technical audiences, including senior executives - you know what altitude is right for each conversation.
Track record of influencing without authority, resolving blockers, and driving cross-org alignment on decisions.
Fluent with AI tools for program management and able to help others build that fluency.
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, IT, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Get to know us
At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality.
Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2026, and included on TIME’s America’s Best Companies 2026 list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.
No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.

Partner with consuming teams - help internal engineers onboard to Temporal, answer questions, debug integration issues, and contribute to documentation that makes adoption easier
Grow your infrastructure skills - work with PostgreSQL, AWS/GCP, Kubernetes networking, Helm chart management, certificate rotation, secret management and distributed systems operations under mentorship

3+ years in DevOps, SRE, platform engineering or infrastructure roles - you've worked on production systems and understand the basics of running services reliably

Helm experience - you've used Helm to deploy applications, understand charts and values files, and can troubleshoot failed releases

Cloud platform exposure - you've worked with AWS or GCP in some capacity; you understand basic compute, networking, and storage primitives but don't need to be an expert
Scripting ability - you can write scripts (Bash, Python, Go) to automate repetitive tasks and build simple tooling
Basic understanding of stateful systems - you've worked with databases (PostgreSQL preferred) or other persistent services and understand backups, schema management, and connection handling at a foundational level

Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.

You've contributed meaningful improvements to dashboards or runbooks
Internal teams reach out to you directly for help with Temporal questions

Experience with FluxCD or ArgoCD in production

Go experience (our services and many consuming applications are written in Go)
Previous work on internal platform teams or DevOps infrastructure roles

jobs.title: Sr Recruiter
jobs.description:
The Company
PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.
We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.
We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.
Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.
Job Summary:
This job develops and executes strategic recruiting plans to attract top talent. They partner with hiring managers to understand specific hiring needs and create job descriptions. Senior Recruiters source and screen candidates, conduct interviews, and assist in the selection and offer process. They also manage relationships with candidates and hiring managers, develop recruiting metrics, and may supervise junior recruiters. With extensive experience in recruiting, they utilize advanced sourcing tools and techniques to ensure the company hires the best talent

Partner with hiring managers and business unit leader to understand hiring requirements, products and services while providing consultative expertise in recruitment.
Lead & develop recruiting strategies and manage the end-to-end hiring activities of assigned requisitions, delivering an efficient and effective recruiting partnership.
Oversees candidates in the talent pipeline through every life cycle stage and develop an outstanding candidate experience and recognition of downstream impact on other disciplines
Advises and influences leaders of assigned business units on Talent Acquisition strategy and how to identify and invest in talent pipeline
Conduct ongoing market research and analysis to develop innovative and effective sourcing strategies, providing market intelligence to the business as required.
Collaborates regularly with peers and/or internal partners
Minimum Qualifications:
3+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.
Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:
What you need to know about the role-
This role is for Technical Recruiter to join the India Talent Acquisition team. Beyond day-to-day hiring, you'll play a key role in shaping and rolling out TA initiatives and projects including recruitment campaigns & marketing, diversity, inclusion, equity and belonging hiring, and our Global TA transformation.
Meet our team-
The TA team is based out of Bangalore in India.
The hiring TA team is responsible for achieving headcount needs for the Engineering & Products organization.Job Description:
Your way to impact-
You will own end-to-end hiring activities across some of our most critical business areas across the India region, partnering closely with Coordination, Onboarding, and Sourcing. Additionally, you'll engage closely with leaders on the site, the broader HR community, and the Global GTA team.
Your day to day-
Achieves staffing objectives by recruiting and evaluating job candidates; advising managers
Educating and guiding hiring managers on Talent Acquisition related policies, processes, and interview skills.
Developing innovative recruitment strategies and managing the end-to-end hiring activities, delivering an efficient and effective service to all involved in the hiring process.
Monitor and ensure 100% compliance with hiring process activities and resolve any discrepancies that may arise prior to the completion of the hiring process
Conduct ongoing market research and analysis to develop innovative and effective sourcing strategies, providing market intelligence to the business as required.
Use various sourcing platforms and techniques LinkedIn, Boolean strings, X-ray search, and other select sourcing tools to further build a robust pipeline of top-tier candidates
Assist in identifying, organizing, attending, and participating in sourcing channels, such as community outreach events, job fairs, Meetups, conferences, educational institutions, non-profit organizations, and social networking activities, on behalf of PayPal, in order to promote PayPal’s employer-brand
Conduct thorough pre-screen activities in line with PayPal and job requirements, and presents a shortlist and recommendations of the most suitable candidates for consideration for assigned requisitions.
Support the administration and coordination of the end-to-end hiring activities of assigned requisitions, ensuring an efficient and effective service is delivered to all involved in the hiring process.
Prepare, present, and negotiate job offers in accordance with PayPal compensation and benefits guidelines.
Manage and actively participate in Talent Acquisition related projects of varying complexity, importance, and priority.
Represent the Talent Acquisition team positively in relationships and communication with the Human Resource Business Partners, Centres of Expertise, business leaders, and other Global Talent Acquisition team members.
What do you need to bring-
5 + years experience with full life cycle talent acquisition in a fast-paced corporate environment.
Comfortable to multitask, project management, and presentation skills coupled with technical / business acumen
Ability to work independently in a dynamic environment of change, challenge, and multiple deadlines and priorities
Experience handling sensitive/confidential information
Networking, and relationship-building skills
High level of comfort with direct sourcing
Subsidiary:
PayPal
Travel Percent:
0
PayPal does not charge candidates any fees for courses, applications, resume reviews, interviews, background checks, or onboarding. When making an application directly, we will never ask you to share passwords, one-time passcodes (OTP), or verification codes. Any such request is a red flag and likely part of a scam. All communication regarding your application will come from official PayPal email domains. If you suspect fraudulent activity, please report it immediately. To learn more about how to identify and avoid recruitment fraud please visit https://careers.pypl.com/contact-us.
For the majority of employees, PayPal's balanced hybrid work model offers 3 days in the office for effective in-person collaboration and 2 days at your choice of either the PayPal office or your home workspace, ensuring that you equally have the benefits and conveniences of both locations.

Belonging at PayPal:

Job Summary:
What you need to know about the role:
We're looking for a Finance Manager to be the analytical engine behind our payments economics. You'll own the data, reporting and dashboards that explain how our Total Processing Volume (TPV), revenue and transaction expenses (interchange, scheme fees and processing fees) turn into transaction margin. Most of our pricing is Interchange++ (IC+), so cost changes flow through to revenue.
Meet our team:
You'll join the Payments Finance team, reporting to the Senior Finance Manager. The team owns revenue and transaction expense performance for the business. We work closely with Accounting on month-end close and reconciliation, with Corporate Finance on forecasting and planning, and with Product on pricing and margin initiatives. We're a small, hands-on team that values curiosity, ownership and clear answers to messy questions.
Job Description:
Essential Responsibilities:
Facilitate collaborative engagement with business to cultivate strong partnership and unlock incremental value for the enterprise
Ensure in-depth understanding of the business to proactively identify key business drivers
Effectively communicate financial results & key drivers through concise & effective storytelling
Streamline, improve, & automate designated workstreams and processes to drive efficiency
Manage business case modeling, run deep dive analysis, and other ad-hoc financial analysis
Monitor expense and headcount plan vs actual and provide analysis/recommendation for business partners and Finance team
Work autonomously but in collaboration with teammates and business partners supporting a global business
Guide the business through various finance-related tasks
Own budgeting, forecasting, month-end close, variance analysis, and reporting
Collaborate with cross-functional teams such as Controllership, Corporate FP&A, Legal, and a broad group of business stakeholders
Minimum Qualifications:
5+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.
Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:
Your way to impact:
Turn transaction-level data into clear insight on what is driving take rate, TE rate and margin: mix, card type, region, merchant segment, scheme fee changes and more.
Build the dashboards leadership uses to monitor payments performance, replacing manual spreadsheets with scalable, automated reporting.
Find margin opportunities, such as interchange optimization, scheme fee leakage, IC+ pass-through gaps and pricing outliers, and size them for Product and leadership.
Improve the accuracy of forecasts by giving Corporate Finance reliable volume and rate drivers.
Strengthen the link between operational data and the general ledger so our numbers tie out.
In your day-to-day role you will be responsible for:
Writing and maintaining SQL queries to pull and transform transaction, revenue and cost data.
Building and maintaining dashboards in [Tableau / Looker / Power BI] tracking TPV, revenue, transaction expenses, take rate, TE rate and margin.
Running monthly and quarterly variance analysis (actual vs. forecast vs. prior period) and explaining the drivers in plain language.
Supporting month-end close by reconciling revenue and transaction expenses with Accounting.
Monitoring scheme fee and interchange changes and quantifying their impact on cost and pass-through.
Doing ad hoc deep dives for leadership and Product, for example merchant profitability or pricing scenarios.
Documenting data definitions and metric logic so everyone uses one version of the truth.
What do you need to bring:
4+ years in FP&A, revenue analytics, business intelligence or a similar analytical role.
Strong SQL skills: joins, window functions, CTEs, and working with large transaction-level datasets.
Hands-on dashboarding experience in Tableau, Looker, Power BI or similar.
Strong Excel/Sheets and financial modeling skills.
A solid grasp of P&L concepts and variance analysis.
The ability to explain complex numbers simply to non-finance partners.
Payments experience is a strong plus: interchange, scheme fees, IC+ vs. blended pricing, acquiring and processing.
Nice to have: Python, or data modeling experience; exposure to multi-currency or cross-border payments.

About the Role:
Notion is looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer focused on migrations to join our growing team in India. You will help deliver complex, production-grade data migrations, integrations, and automations for customers across APAC.
This is initially an internally focused, hands-on engineering role. You will partner closely with regional Forward Deployed Engineers, who own customer discovery, solution architecture, stakeholder communication, risk management, and final customer validation. You will own the behind-the-scenes technical execution layer from feasibility assessment and implementation through testing, production rollout, QA, reconciliation, reporting, and operational handoff.
You will work across multiple customer environments and source systems, often with incomplete requirements, imperfect data, and real-world constraints. Success requires strong engineering fundamentals, sound judgment, careful validation, and the ability to turn one-off delivery work into reusable tools and repeatable playbooks.
As a founding engineer in India, you will help build a new regional engineering capability from the ground up. You will create migration infrastructure, standards, and reusable tooling used by FDEs across APAC, while establishing practices that can scale globally. The role offers an opportunity to become a technical authority for production migration delivery, shaping how Notion approaches reliability, validation, and operational quality across complex customer environments. As the team grows, the role may also expand toward customer-facing FDE work, technical leadership, or a deeper engineering path, depending on business needs and demonstrated capability.
What You'll Achieve:
Own the technical execution layer after customer requirements, scope, and solution architecture have been established with the regional FDE. Contribute to feasibility assessment, estimation, implementation planning, and risk identification while the regional FDE remains accountable for customer discovery, scope, architecture, stakeholder communication, and final acceptance.
Apply a repeatable migration lifecycle covering source inventory and sampling, scope and pruning decisions, compatibility and degradation assessment, transformation design, pilot or dry run, user acceptance testing, production cutover, reconciliation, remediation, hypercare, and documented handoff.
Translate approved customer and regional FDE requirements into clear technical designs, implementation plans, test strategies, runbooks, and delivery estimates.
Build production-quality migration utilities, backend services, data pipelines, integrations, and automations using Python, SQL, APIs, databases, and cloud infrastructure.
Investigate source-system behavior, data quality issues, permissions, rate limits, authentication constraints, and edge cases, then recommend practical solutions.
Design and validate permissions, ownership, and inheritance mappings against the approved migration plan. Make unsupported or ambiguous access requirements explicit, obtain the required decision or approval, and preserve evidence of validation.
Design migrations for reliability, scale, security, observability, idempotency, failure recovery, and safe reruns.
Execute migrations only through approved environments, devices, accounts, and tooling. Follow least-privilege access, customer-specific security and data-residency requirements, and approved handling procedures. Do not store customer data in unmanaged local or external systems, and escalate privacy, security, or sovereignty concerns before execution.
Build validation and reconciliation frameworks that provide clear evidence of migration completeness, accuracy, and exceptions.
Debug failures across application code, infrastructure, customer data, third-party systems, and the Notion platform, then drive issues through resolution.
Manage multiple implementation workstreams, dependencies, and priorities while communicating scope, progress, risks, and trade-offs clearly.
Surface scope changes, unsupported requirements, timeline risks, and material effort increases early. Document assumptions and trade-offs, and escalate with options and a recommended path rather than silently absorbing additional work.
Maintain an auditable record of scope, decisions, risks, approvals, validation evidence, and customer acceptance criteria in the agreed shared workspace or channel.
Convert repeated delivery patterns into reusable components, automation, documentation, and playbooks that improve speed, quality, and cost over time.
Bring field learnings back to Notion's Product and Engineering teams as actionable platform feedback and technical requirements.
Skills You'll Need to Bring:
3 to 6 years of hands-on experience in backend engineering, data engineering, integration engineering, implementation engineering, technical consulting, solutions engineering, or a similar technical role.
Strong hands-on Python development experience.
Working experience with Node.js, JavaScript, or TypeScript.
Strong SQL skills and a solid understanding of relational databases, data modeling, and data transformation.
Experience working with REST APIs, JSON, authentication, webhooks, and system integrations.
Experience owning a production migration, integration, or technical implementation through mapping, transformation, testing, rollout, validation, and handoff.
Experience taking a technical problem from requirements and design through development, testing, deployment, and production operation.
Experience with Git, code review, automated testing, release practices, and production deployment.
Strong debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills across code, data, infrastructure, and external systems.
Evidence of working on production systems, not only prototypes or proof-of-concept projects.
Clear written and verbal English communication, with the ability to explain technical decisions, constraints, and risks to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
High agency and ownership. You are comfortable making progress with incomplete information, challenging assumptions, and escalating with options and a recommendation.
Nice to Haves:
Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, job orchestration, or infrastructure automation.
Experience with AWS, GCP, or Azure.
Familiarity with message queues, event-driven systems, distributed-system patterns, retries, concurrency, and rate limits.
Experience with monitoring, logging, alerting, or other observability tools.
Experience with enterprise SaaS applications, professional services, or large-scale customer implementations.
Experience migrating large volumes of content or structured data between enterprise platforms.
Experience with AI or LLM applications, retrieval-augmented generation, evaluation frameworks, or agentic workflows.
Familiarity with MCP, tool calling, Notion Workers, Custom Agents, or similar extensibility platforms.
Experience working with distributed global or APAC teams.
What success looks like:
In your first 90 days, you will:
Learn Notion's migration and implementation ecosystem, engineering standards, and APAC delivery model.
Establish a productive working rhythm with regional FDE partners.
Contribute to at least one migration or integration workstream through production delivery.
Leave behind clear technical documentation, validation evidence, and an operational runbook.
Within your first six months, you will:
Independently own production migration or integration workstreams from technical design through rollout and handoff.
Deliver measurable improvements in migration turnaround time, validation quality, delivery cost, or regional FDE execution hours through reusable engineering.
Help establish repeatable quality controls, code review practices, runbooks, and observability patterns for the India team.
Demonstrate effective prioritization and communication across multiple concurrent APAC engagements.
Turn at least one repeated delivery pattern into a reusable tool, component, or playbook that is adopted by a subsequent engagement.
Location:
This role is based in Hyderabad, India. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays, our Anchor Days, because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We're looking for someone who's excited to work alongside the team during those days.

jobs.title: Executive, Finance
jobs.description:
Razorpay is one of India’s leading full-stack financial technology companies, powering the way businesses move, manage, and grow money. Founded in 2014 by Harshil Mathur and Shashank Kumar with a simple vision - to simplify payments for Indian businesses - we’ve since grown into a fintech powerhouse driving India’s digital payment revolution.
Razorpay powers millions of businesses with a smarter, scalable stack that goes beyond transactions to help them truly build and grow.
From building AI-native agentic payments, to AI-assisted fraud detection and real-time risk intelligence to automated reconciliation, smart payouts, and predictive financial insights, we are embedding intelligence across our stack to make money movement faster, safer, and more efficient. In close collaboration with ecosystem partners - including banks, networks, regulators - we are pioneering industry-first solutions that are shaping the next era of fintech
Across India, Singapore and Malaysia, our products span everything from seamless checkouts to payroll automation - powering a fintech ecosystem that’s redefining how money moves across Asia.
Today, that ecosystem supports everyone from early-stage startups to some of India’s largest enterprises, enabling them to accept, process, and disburse payments at scale while expanding into new ways of managing money more efficiently.
Our scale speaks volumes: Razorpay processes $180+ billion in annualized transactions, powering leading businesses like Airbnb, Facebook, WhatsApp, Airtel, CRED, BookmyShow, Zomato, Swiggy, Lenskart, Mirae Asset Capital markets, Indian Oil, National Pension Scheme - and over 100 of India’s unicorns. With strong roots in India and growing operations in Southeast Asia, we are shaping the next chapter of financial technology across the region.
We are backed by global investors including GIC, Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India & SEA), Tiger Global, Ribbit Capital, Matrix Partners, MasterCard, and Salesforce Ventures, having raised over $740 million to date. Strategic acquisitions - including Ezetap (POS and offline payments), Curlec (Malaysia expansion), BillMe (digital invoicing), and POP (rewards-first UPI) - along with earlier moves in fraud prevention, payroll, and lending, have further strengthened our platform and widened our footprint across Asia.
But what truly sets Razorpay apart is our culture. At Razorpay, ownership is our oxygen - you own what you build, with no micromanagement or red tape, just the runway to make your ideas fly. Learning is a lifestyle - if you’re curious, you’ll feel at home here. People > Pedigree - we hire for attitude, hustle, and hunger more than degrees. Transparency thrives over titles - this is where interns question CXOs and CXOs say “thank you.” Guided by our values of Customer First, Autonomy & Ownership, Agility with Integrity, Transparency, Challenging the status quo and a strong belief that Razorpay grows with Razors,  you’ll be part of a 3000+ strong team building not just products, but the financial infrastructure of the future.
Job Overview:
We are seeking an enthusiastic and detail-oriented Accounting professional to manage key Accounts Payable processes within the finance function of Razorpay. The incumbent will work closely with the finance team and many other departments and external stakeholders  to ensure efficient management of the accounts payable function, accurate financial reporting, compliance with statutory requirements, and implementation of best practices and controls
Key Responsibilities:
Invoice Processing & Vendor Management
Review, code, and enter vendor invoices, purchase orders (POs), and contracts into the accounting/ERP software 
Perform 3-way matching (Invoice vs. Purchase Order vs. SOD) to ensure payment accuracy
Handle vendor onboarding, verify bank details, and maintain active, compliant vendor master records
Address vendor payment inquiries and resolve billing/discrepancy issues in a timely, professional manner
Statutory Compliance & Tax Deductions (India)
Ensure accurate deduction and filing support for TDS (Tax Deductions at Source) on qualifying vendor payments under relevant Sections (e.g., 194C, 194J, 194Q).
Verify GST details on incoming invoices to ensure valid Input Tax Credit (ITC) claimability (matching with GSTR-2B data).
Payment Processing & Reconciliations
Assist in preparing batch electronic payouts via Corporate Net Banking, ACH, NEFT, RTGS, and FinTech payment payout rails/APIs.
Reconcile vendor ledgers, monthly supplier statements, and petty cash logs. 
Assist in month-end AP closing routines, aging analysis, and expense accrual computations. 
Employee Expenses & Audit Support
Process employee expense reports and reimbursements via corporate tools in line with company travel and expense policy.
Maintain digital repository for all receipts, tax invoices, contracts, and payment vouchers for easy retrieval.
Support internal, statutory, and tax audit processes by pulling required document samples and schedules.
Qualifications & Skills:
Accounts Payable professional with 1-2 years work experience 
In-depth knowledge of accounting principles, TDS, GST
Strong Excel skills; Working knowledge of SAP
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills.
Ability to manage multiple tasks and work under pressure to meet deadlines.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate across departments and with external stakeholders.
Razorpay believes in and follows an equal employment opportunity policy that doesn't discriminate on gender, religion, sexual orientation, colour, nationality, age, etc. We welcome interests and applications from all groups and communities across the globe.

Payment Gateway Sales & Business Development

Payment Gateway Sales & Business Development

Call inbound and outbound leads to understand their business details.
Qualify leads based on criteria like business type, turnover, GST, etc.

Update lead status and notes in CRM or Google Sheets.
Tag leads as hot, disqualified, or nurture based on outcomes.

You will work with modern generative AI — LLM orchestration, autonomous agent loops, tool calling and RAG — against real enterprise infrastructure, building agents that carry out multi-step business workflows, act on data across these systems through their APIs, and hand back to a human when they should.
At Palo Alto Networks we are moving towards an AI-First engineering culture, and you will not be starting from a blank page. You will build on our own internal AI platform tools for test generation, automation scripting, execution and quality reporting.
Agentic Systems & Enterprise Integration
Build agentic features: Develop and maintain agent workflows using LangGraph, ADK, LangChain, AutoGen or CrewAI, including planner/executor loops, state handling and failure recovery.
Enable cross-system integration and tool calling: Connect agents across enterprise applications, including: Salesforce: REST/SOAP APIs, Webhooks, Platform Events, Apex Invocable Methods, SOQL and Flows. SAP: OData/BAPI services and business-object events. Custom applications: Licensing, Entitlement, AI Custom Quoting, Provisioning and ITSM through REST APIs, webhooks and message queues.
Build context grounding and RAG pipelines: Use vector stores such as pgvector, Pinecone and Weaviate to provide LLMs with accurate, current enterprise context.
Define tools and schemas: Create well-specified tool definitions and JSON function schemas, including MCP tools, to support deterministic tool calls and traceability back to Jira.
Agent Quality, Safety & Observability
Build evaluation suites: Develop and run golden-set evaluations to validate improvements to agents and prompts before release.
Implement guardrails and human-in-the-loop workflows: Establish safety controls, rate limiting, fallbacks and clear approval handoffs, especially when agents write to systems of record.
Enable observability: Instrument agents with tracing and metrics covering execution paths, latency, context usage and token costs, and use findings to improve performance.
Apply responsible AI practices: Follow company policies on intellectual property and data privacy, keep secrets in managed stores and require explicit opt-in for steps that send content to external services.
Collaboration & Growth
Collaborate across functions: Partner with Salesforce, SAP and platform architects, QE leads, product managers and security teams to deliver reliable AI features that meet business, quality and enterprise compliance requirements.
Learn the enterprise landscape: Build an understanding of transaction flows from AI Custom Quoting and order capture through licensing, entitlement, provisioning and service management. Prior knowledge is not required, but proactive learning is expected.
Share knowledge: Contribute working examples, reusable tools and reviewed code to strengthen AI fluency across engineering teams.
Qualifications
Experience: 1–4 years of professional software engineering experience or equivalent demonstrable capability.
Programming: Strong proficiency in Python or TypeScript/Node.js, with sound fundamentals in data structures, testing and code review.
Backend fundamentals: Practical experience building and consuming REST APIs, working with relational databases and handling asynchronous or queue-based processing.
Hands-on LLM experience: Demonstrable experience with LLM APIs, including prompting, function/tool calling and structured outputs, through professional work, internships, open-source contributions or substantial personal projects.
Agentic or RAG exposure: Built at least one working agent or retrieval pipeline end to end, with the ability to explain its design, failures and improvements.
Integration skills: Comfortable reading unfamiliar enterprise API documentation and determining how to integrate safely.
Version control and CI: Comfortable using Git in a team environment and working with automated build and test pipelines.
AI-assisted development: Daily working fluency with tools such as Cursor, Claude Code or GitHub Copilot, with the judgement to critically review generated output.
Education: B.E./B.Tech/M.Tech in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
Preferred Qualifications
Production agents: Experience deploying AI agents or LLM features into production, including multi-agent coordination or autonomous decision loops.
Enterprise application knowledge: Exposure to one or more of the following: Salesforce: REST/Composite/Bulk APIs, SOQL/SOSL, Connected Apps, OAuth and Apex. SAP: OData, BAPI/RFC, IDocs or business-object events. Enterprise platforms: AI Custom Quoting, Provisioning, Licensing/Entitlement or ITSM platforms and their supporting distributed services.
Vector databases and embeddings: Experience with semantic search, embedding generation and vector engines such as pgvector, Pinecone, Qdrant or ChromaDB.
Advanced retrieval: Familiarity with Graph RAG, Corrective RAG, HyDE or agentic retrieval, and graph stores such as Apache AGE or Neo4j.
Model Context Protocol: Experience authoring MCP servers, including tools, resources and prompts.
Cloud and DevOps: Exposure to GCP, AWS or Azure, containerisation using Docker or Kubernetes, and serverless computing. Vertex AI experience is a plus.
Test automation: Familiarity with Playwright, REST Assured, Selenium or PyTest.
Domain interest: Grounding in B2B sales processes, Partner Relationship Management (PRM) or the Quote-to-Cash lifecycle.
Ways of Working
Evidence over assertion: Measure results before and after changes, share findings with the methodology and clearly acknowledge inconclusive outcomes.
Curiosity with rigour: Explore new tools, validate them before adoption and understand the difference between a demo and a reliable system.
Ownership: Take tasks from ambiguity through delivery and raise blockers early.
Builder’s bias: Prioritise shipping focused, reliable capabilities that users can trust over broad features that only perform well in demonstrations.
Growth Path
Join at the AI Engineer tier of the internal AI capability ladder, between AI User and AI Architect.
Progress towards AI Architect, building expertise in: Planner–executor orchestration at scale. Multi-agent systems with human-in-the-loop controls. Event-driven integration across enterprise IT systems. Model customisation.
Access company-funded training to support this progression.
The Team
Join a growing, passionate and dynamic team working on challenging, mission-driven projects.
Contribute to a people-centric culture focused on creating an exceptional employee experience.

Job Description:
Job Description and Responsibilities
The Cyber Security division of Broadcom’s Global Technology Organization (GTO) is a technology forward organization constantly looking for new innovative solutions to implement while making security the base principle, not just the perimeter. Broadcom GTO implements leading edge new technologies and services that increase the effectiveness and efficiencies of the workforce.
This position is based in Bangalore, India, reporting to the Identity Platform Architect & Manager. The role is focused on supporting, administering, and securing Broadcom’s core Identity and Access Management (IAM), Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA), and physical security infrastructure. A degree in Information Technology with a minimum of 5 years IT Support experience is desired. This is a full-time, in-office position (no remote work).
Key Responsibilities
1. Core Identity & Access Management (IAM) Administration
SSO & Federated Identity: Ensure high availability, stability, and tier-3 support for enterprise Single Sign-On (SSO) platforms, industry leading identity providers, and protocols (SAML, OAuth, SCIMv2).
Security, Vulnerability & PII Governance: Address identified vulnerabilities in a timely manner. Strictly govern Personally Identifiable Information (PII) handling and enforce corporate security policies across all identity systems.
Active Directory: Practical knowledge of Active Directory environments. Support, manage, and troubleshoot user, group, and core object management issues.
Logging & Analytics: Utilize SIEM and logging platforms for real-time audit logging, incident investigation, and parsing rule creation.
2. Enterprise Network Security & ZTNA
Zero Trust & Network Security: Oversee deployment, policy enforcement, and compliance tracking for ZTNA, Secure Web Gateways, and VPN solutions.
Endpoint Agent Health: Monitor agent compliance, resolve edge-case user authentication issues (e.g., blank auth windows, proxy avoidance blocks), and tune alerts to reduce noise.
3. Physical Security & Camera Infrastructure (Card & Camera)
Knowledge of Windows Server: Experience in troubleshooting Windows Server related issues. Able to analyse the logs to identify the root cause (RCA).
Camera Operations: Oversee technical operations, firmware upgrades, and security baselines for Video Management Systems and camera fleets globally (AMER, EMEA, APAC, INDIA).
High Availability (HA) & Integrations: Design and execute High Availability (HA) architectures across data centers for management/recording servers. Integrate physical access control systems with central identity platforms and digital badging initiatives.
Required Skills & Experience
Technical Proficiencies
Identity & Access Management: Deep practical knowledge of industry standard identity providers, federation standards (SAML, OAuth, SCIMv2), and large-scale, multi-domain Active Directory environments.
ZTNA & Network Security: Demonstrated proficiency with ZTNA architectures, Secure Web Gateways, VPNs, and firewall policy management.
Physical Access & Video Management: Direct operational experience with Video Management Software, IP camera management tools, and Access Control Systems.
Analytics & ITSM: Experience using SIEM, Log analytics, and ITSM/project tools.
Scripting & Automation (Nice-to-Have): Familiarity with scripting languages (e.g., PowerShell, Python) or workflow automation tools to help streamline repetitive operational tasks is a plus.
Professional Competencies
Proactive Mindset: Highly self-motivated with a deterministic approach to solving complex engineering challenges with minimal supervision.
Operational Excellence: Strong background in root-cause analysis (RCA), disaster recovery planning, high-availability architecture design, and operationalizing new enterprise services.
Documentation & Communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with proven ability to craft standard operating procedures, architectural blueprints, technical knowledge bases, and executive updates.

jobs.description:
Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase, we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” learn more about working at Coinbase.
Staff Software Engineer, Customer Administration
The Customer Administration Engineering (CAE) team is a core pillar of Coinbase's Enterprise Applications and Architecture (EAA) org, responsible for building and operating the secure, foundational platforms that power customer data operations across Coinbase. Our flagship product, Control Center, is Coinbase's secure system of action for internal specialists across CX, Compliance, Legal, Global Investigations, Trust and Risk, and dozens of other teams. It serves approximately 7,000 internal users via its UI and powers a growing ecosystem of internal tools and AI automation via its backend APIs and MCP. We are at an exciting inflection point: evolving Control Center from a human-specialist UI into a modular, AI-agent-ready operations platform. As a Staff Software Engineer, you will be a technical anchor for the CAE team, driving architectural decisions, mentoring engineers, and leading the delivery of high-impact, cross-cutting platform capabilities.
What You'll Do
Architect and deliver foundational platform capabilities including MCP tool registries, AI orchestration layers, risk-based access automation, and the away-team contribution model that enables product groups across Coinbase to build on the platform safely and at speed
Drive the evolution of Control Center into an AI-agent-ready, headless operations platform, designing and implementing MCP procedure constructs, agentic guardrails, HITL orchestration, and evaluation frameworks that enable both human and autonomous AI agents to execute sensitive customer operations securely
Partner with the Engineering Manager and Product counterparts to define architectural roadmaps, author TDDs, lead design reviews, decompose complex initiatives into deliverable milestones, and raise the engineering quality bar through code review and mentorship
Build and maintain highly reliable, secure, distributed backend services, owning SLO definitions, observability instrumentation, incident response, and operational readiness for Tier-1 platform systems
Collaborate across EAA engineering teams, Product Engineering, and Security Engineering to deliver cross-functional outcomes and drive shared platform primitives that eliminate duplicated infrastructure across the portfolio
Required Skills and Experience
8+ years of hands-on software engineering experience, with a demonstrated track record of architecting and delivering large-scale, high-traffic distributed systems in production, including deep proficiency in backend service design, API development (gRPC, MCP, GraphQL), and scalable microservices architectures
Proven ability to independently lead ambiguous, high-impact technical initiatives from whiteboard to production, writing high-quality, well-tested code and setting the standard for others across complex, multi-team problem spaces
Strong experience with cloud-native infrastructure and the modern backend stack: AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, BuildKite/CircleCI, event-driven architectures (Kafka, MQ), distributed caching (Redis/Memcached), and proficiency in SQL and/or NoSQL databases
Track record of building secure, compliant internal tools or platforms, with deep appreciation for security controls, access management, audit logging, data governance, and engineering rigor in a regulated financial services environment
Experience building or integrating with agentic AI systems, including MCP servers, LLM orchestration layers, RAG pipelines, HITL workflows, or evaluation and guardrail frameworks for production agentic workloads
Proficiency in Go (Golang) as a primary backend language, with willingness to work across Python where applicable in the evolving AI stack
Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.

The Sr. Construction Scheduler is responsible for reviewing and analyzing General Contractors’ schedules and reporting on schedule health to the Project Team and other key stakeholders. This role involves working closely with NTT’s Construction Team and General Contractors to drive consistency, accountability, and adherence to established scheduling standards across all projects.
The Construction Scheduler will also support the analysis of schedule delays by reviewing, summarizing, and comparing General Contractors’ Time Impact Analyses (TIAs) against other available project data. KEY RESPONSIBLITIES
Lead baseline schedule development by partnering with NTT’s General Contractors to establish accurate, fully logic-driven project baselines.
Review General Contractors’ project schedules to identify potential risks, constraints, and sequencing issues, with a proactive focus on mitigation and recovery strategies.

Ensure client-specific scheduling requirements are met, including compliance with contractual obligations, reporting standards, and project specific deliverables.
Develop schedule what-if scenarios and perform comparative schedule assessments to inform and drive data-based decision making.
Champion and support the implementation of scheduling best practices across GID, driving standardization of processes, templates, coding structures, and reporting methodologies to ensure consistency, data integrity, and alignment with portfolio-level controls and governance standards.
Develop meaningful scheduling key performance indicators (KPIs) that accurately reflect project progress at any given point in time, enabling clear visibility into performance against baseline.
Review Time Impact Analyses (TIAs) and provide structured feedback to the Construction Team and General Contractors.
Partner with project stakeholders to support planning efforts and maintain schedule control throughout the project lifecycle by developing and managing internal schedules that accurately reflect current progress across all phases.
Lead schedule progress meetings with the Construction Team and General Contractors to review status, validate updates, and address variances.
Perform any other related tasks as required.
KNOWLEDGE & ATTRIBUTES
Fully versed in Critical Path Method (CPM) scheduling requirements for construction projects, including development and maintenance of logic-driven schedules, critical path analysis, risk assessment, and adherence to contractual scheduling specifications.
Experience with Earned Value Management (EVM) and the ability to apply its principles in internal schedule and performance reporting.
Proficient in Primavera (P6) and Microsoft Project (MSP) scheduling software.
Demonstrated ability to read and interpret construction drawings and specifications to analyze and evaluate contractor-produced schedules.
Excellent analytical skills, creative thinking ability, and strong written and verbal communication skills.
Experience reviewing Time Impact Analyses (TIAs) and recovery schedules to assess schedule impacts and proposed mitigation strategies.
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple tasks effectively in a fast-paced environment.
Ability to clearly set and lead meetings to develop strong project control systems
Ability to be highly confidential.
Proficient in Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook
Ability to work effectively in a collaborative team environment.
Ability to manage stress effectively in a fast-paced work environment.
ACADEMIC QUALIFICATIONS & CERTIFICATIONS
Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Engineering, or a related field.
Professional certification such as PSP is preferred.
REQUIRED EXPERIENCE
8 - 12 years of experience in construction scheduling, including baseline schedule development, critical path and variance analysis, earned value management (EVM), and forensic schedule analysis.
Experience with Data Center construction projects is preferred.
PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS
Primarily sitting with some walking, standing, and bending.
Able to hear and speak into a telephone.
Close visual work on a computer terminal.
Dexterity of hands and fingers to operate any required computer keyboard, mouse, and other technical instruments.
Able to lift and carry up to 20 lbs.

This role is expected to be remote with an occasional need to be on-site and/or construction jobsite.

Workday is expanding our presence in India, one of our most important growth markets and a key to achieving our APAC ambitions. - Deepening Our Partner Ecosystem: Our partners are an extension of us, and by deepening these crucial relationships in India, we can drive greater reach, impact, and shared success.

Excellent verbal and written communication skills

8+ years' total experience
Design, configure, implement, and maintain enterprise-level network infrastructure, including routers, switches (campus and data center), firewalls, wireless access points, and related services.

Deploying, managing, and troubleshooting Zscaler Private Service Edges (PSEs) for optimized and secure access to internal applications via ZPA.

Configuring traffic forwarding, security policies, and application segments.
Lead network infrastructure projects from conception to completion, including requirements gathering, design, planning, execution, and post-implementation support, ensuring clear communication with all stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle.

Mentor junior network engineers and provide technical guidance and support, fostering their communication and technical skills.
