About NCR Atleos
NCR Atleos Corporation (NYSE: NATL) is a global technology company that enables financial access and commerce through assisted and self-service solutions and comprehensive support services. NCR Atleos serves financial and public-sector organizations in more than 100 countries and is headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, USA.
The opportunity
As an Application Security Compliance Lead, you will help ensure that NCR Atleos software products and development practices meet applicable security, privacy and regulatory requirements. Working within our global Application Security team, you will turn complex requirements into practical guidance, prepare teams for assessments, and help demonstrate that security and privacy are embedded throughout the software lifecycle.
A major focus is organization-level PCI Software Security Framework (SSF) activities: support product teams to achieve and retain PCI Secure Software Standard listings and maintain validation of our Secure Software Lifecycle practices. This role suits someone who combines compliance expertise with software development and application security knowledge.
What you will do
Govern the Secure SDLC. Maintain and improve practices aligned with the PCI Secure SLC Standard.
Enable PCI SSF validation. Guide teams through external assessment, self-assessment, annual attestation and periodic revalidation activities.
Interpret requirements. Translate security, privacy, legal and industry requirements into clear, proportionate guidance.
Assess readiness and close gaps. Coordinate reviews, evidence, gap analysis, remediation and resolution of findings.
Engage and influence. Partner with engineering, Legal, risk, compliance and security teams, QSAs and the PCI SSC.
Build capability. Create training and reusable guidance; monitor developments and communicate material changes.
Drive continual improvement. Use industry changes, stakeholder feedback, internal audits, assessment outcomes, recurring findings, and incidents to strengthen controls and processes.
What you will bring
Essential experience and capabilities
Typically, 7+ years of relevant experience in application security, software security assurance, secure software development, technology risk, privacy, compliance, or audit.
Practical experience developing, operating, governing or assessing a Secure SDLC.
Experience interpreting security or compliance requirements and supporting assessments, evidence collection, gap analysis and remediation.
Working knowledge of threat modelling, vulnerability management, security testing, and risk-based decision-making.
Technical understanding of cloud services, source-code management, and CI/CD practices sufficient to engage credibly with engineering teams.
Ability to convert complex requirements into pragmatic guidance and make evidence-based recommendations.
Strong stakeholder management, communication, analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to influence without direct authority.
Ability to work independently and effectively within a globally distributed team.
Comfortable using AI assistants, such as Copilot, responsibly in day-to-day work to improve personal productivity, quality, and speed of delivery.
A bachelor’s degree in a STEM discipline, or equivalent relevant professional experience and qualifications.
Desirable experience and capabilities
Direct experience of PCI SSF validation or a comparable software security assurance framework.
Knowledge of payment-card security, GDPR requirements, NIST CSF and OWASP standards and guidance.
Experience delivering application security or compliance-related training.
Knowledge of security and governance for AI-enabled software development and products.
A relevant certification, such as CISSP, CSSLP, CIPP, CIPT or CIPM.
How you will succeed
Teams receive clear, timely, and actionable compliance guidance.
PCI SSF validation activities are well planned, appropriately evidenced, and progressed effectively.
Compliance gaps and findings are clearly owned, prioritized, tracked, and resolved.
Secure SDLC requirements remain practical, current, and consistently understood.
Assessment and incident lessons lead to sustainable improvements and strong stakeholder relationships.
Evidence we value
In your application, we would particularly welcome examples of how you have interpreted a security standard, prepared a product or organization for assessment, resolved a significant compliance gap, or influenced an engineering team to adopt a more effective security practice.

jobs.description:
About NCR Atleos
NCR Atleos, headquartered in Atlanta, is a leader in expanding financial access. Our dedicated 20,000 employees optimize the branch, improve operational efficiency and maximize self-service availability for financial institutions and retailers across the globe.
Security Officer (Physical Security Operations)
Experience: 8–10 Years
Role Purpose:
The Security Officer is responsible for managing end-to-end physical security operations, including day-to-day security activities, manpower deployment, creation and implementation of SOPs, vendor coordination, monthly billing validation, and management of security automation systems. The role requires strong operational control, process orientation, and coordination with internal and external stakeholders.
Key Responsibilities
1. Physical Security Operations
Manage day-to-day physical security operations across assigned sites/facilities.
Ensure protection of employees, visitors, assets, and infrastructure.
Oversee access control, perimeter security, surveillance, and patrolling activities.
Conduct routine inspections, audits, and compliance checks.
2. Manpower Management & Deployment
Plan, deploy, and supervise security manpower as per operational and risk requirements.
Prepare duty rosters, shift schedules, relievers, and leave planning.
Monitor guard performance, discipline, and adherence to SOPs.
Address issues related to absenteeism, misconduct, and operational gaps.
3. SOP Development & Compliance
- Create, implement, and periodically review security SOPs and post orders, including:
Visitor management
Material movement (inward/outward)
Access control procedures
Emergency response and incident handling
Ensure SOP compliance through training, audits, and mock drills.
Maintain documentation for audits and management review.
4. Security Automation & Systems
- Manage and monitor security automation systems such as:
CCTV and Video Management Systems (VMS)
Access Control Systems (ACS)
Alarm and intrusion detection systems
Coordinate with vendors for installation, maintenance, and troubleshooting.
Ensure system uptime, reporting, and basic first-level issue resolution.
5. Vendor Management & Monthly Billing
Coordinate with security service providers and related vendors.
Validate monthly security bills, attendance sheets, OT claims, and deployment strength.
Ensure billing accuracy as per contract, SLA, and approved manpower.
Highlight discrepancies and follow up for corrective action.
6. Incident Management & Reporting
Respond to security incidents, breaches, thefts, and emergencies.
Conduct preliminary investigations and prepare incident reports with root-cause analysis.
Recommend corrective and preventive measures.
Liaise with local authorities and emergency services when required.
7. Reporting & MIS
Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly security reports and MIS.
Track incidents, manpower, audits, automation uptime, and billing data.
Present observations and improvement plans to management.
Key Skills & Competencies
Strong knowledge of physical security operations
Experience in manpower management and deployment
SOP drafting and process implementation skills
Working knowledge of CCTV, ACS, VMS, and security automation
Vendor coordination and billing validation experience
Good communication, leadership, and reporting skills
Proficiency in MS Word, Excel, and basic reporting tools
Qualification
Graduate in any discipline (preferred)
Defense, paramilitary, or professional security background is an advantage
Relevant security or safety certifications are an added advantage
Experience Requirement
Minimum 8–10 years of relevant experience in physical security operations
Experience in corporate offices, factories, pharma, IT parks, or large facilities preferred
Exposure to multi-site operations and security automation is highly desirable

jobs.description:

Automate the agreed Sales Cloud and FSC workflows (for example lead creation and conversion, account and contact updates, opportunity stage progression, campaign members and pipeline views)
Write dependable locators for Lightning and LWC pages, including Shadow DOM, and build reusable page components
Create data-driven tests using synthetic or masked data, and set up and clean up test data safely in the sandbox
Configure self-healing and run controlled application-change scenarios agreed with the client to show it working; capture the results
Handle authentication for automation users, including MFA, in line with the approach the client approves
Execute suites, analyze failures, separate product defects from flaky tests, and report pass rate, stability and execution time
Document the suites and contribute to the run-book; follow the client’s security and VDI rules at all times
MUST-HAVE SKILLS
4–7 years in UI test automation, with at least 2 years on Salesforce Lightning applications
Hands-on Playwright with JavaScript or TypeScript, or Selenium with Java or Python and a willingness to move to Playwright quickly
Good understanding of Salesforce objects such as leads, accounts, contacts, opportunities and campaigns, and of standard Salesforce data setup
Page Object Model and data-driven design; Git; clear test reporting; basic SQL
Skill in diagnosing flaky tests and unstable locators
Comfort working in Agile teams and with an onsite lead across time zones
GOOD TO HAVE
Experience with AI-assisted or self-healing test tools, or Provar, ACCELQ or Copado Robotic Testing
Salesforce data setup through REST API or SOQL; CI tools such as Jenkins or GitHub Actions
Insurance or financial services domain exposure; Salesforce Administrator certification

Design and automate API tests for the MuleSoft layer: request and response checks, field-level mapping and transformation, and error handling
Validate flows that start in Salesforce and pass through MuleSoft to downstream systems, then reconcile the final outcome back on the Salesforce record
Test file-based and batch integrations over SFTP: file creation, format and schema checks (CSV, XML, fixed-width), pick-up timing and reconciliation, organized as batch or day-wise suites
Build service virtualization for systems that are not reachable in test, including an SFTP file-drop simulator for AWD-style status files; tools such as WireMock or Hoverfly, or small Node services
Work with the Salesforce automation engineer to chain steps into end-to-end suites, handling polling and waits for asynchronous results
Prepare synthetic test data, check results with SQL or API calls, and keep clear evidence for the client readout

5–8 years in API and integration test automation
REST and SOAP, JSON and XML; tools such as Postman, REST Assured or Playwright API testing; scripting in JavaScript, TypeScript or Java
Experience testing file-based or batch integrations (SFTP, scheduled jobs, file formats) and asynchronous patterns such as polling and queues
Hands-on use of at least one service virtualization or mocking tool
Strong SQL for data checks and reconciliation
Ability to read integration specifications and data mappings and turn them into test cases
GOOD TO HAVE
MuleSoft Anypoint, DataWeave, RAML or OpenAPI; Salesforce REST API or Platform Events
AWD, BPM, workflow or document-imaging systems; message queues; AWS S3

jobs.description:
What success looks like in this role:
Job Title: Senior Service Management Transformation Specialist
Location: Bangalore
Who we are:
Unisys is a global information technology company that builds high-performance, security-centric solutions for the most digitally demanding businesses and governments on Earth. Unisys’ offerings include security software and services; digital transformation and workplace services; industry applications and services; and innovative software operating environments for high-intensity enterprise computing. Unisys builds better outcomes securely for its clients across the Government, Financial Services and Commercial markets. For more information, visit www.unisys.com.
Our Vision: Enhancing people’s lives through secure, reliable advanced technology.
Our Core Beliefs:
Curiosity: We embrace the unknown and continuous learning.
Creativity: We look past routine ways of doing things.
Client-Centricity: Our clients’ success is our success.
Integrity: We act ethically and honestly.
Role Purpose
Support and deliver Service Management transformation initiatives across client environments, improving how Incident, Major Incident, Problem, Change and related practices operate. The role combines strong Service Management knowledge with practical exposure to automation, AI, analytics, observability and modern engineering practices. The individual is expected to identify opportunities, work effectively with technical teams and independently own defined improvement initiatives from analysis through implementation.
Key Responsibilities
Service Management Improvement
· Assess existing Incident, Major Incident, Problem, Change and related operational practices.
· Identify process friction, unnecessary governance, repetitive work and opportunities for simplification.
· Own defined improvement initiatives from assessment through implementation and benefit tracking.
· Help shift Service Management measures from activity and volume toward stability, prevention, efficiency and business outcomes.
Problem Management and Service Stability
· Analyse incidents, recurring failures, work notes, monitoring events, changes and other operational data to identify problem candidates.
· Drive proactive Problem Management and recurring-incident prevention within assigned scope.
· Work with resolver and engineering teams to convert analysis into corrective and preventive actions.
· Measure avoided recurrence, reduced operational effort and improved service stability.
Change Management Modernisation
· Identify change activities suitable for standardisation, automation and simplified risk-based governance.
· Support integration between Change Management and CI/CD or engineering workflows.
· Help reduce unnecessary manual governance while maintaining appropriate risk, audit and compliance controls.
· Contribute to models where high-risk changes receive focused review and lower-risk changes follow proportionate controls.
AI, Automation and Analytics
· Use approved tools such as Microsoft Copilot, Claude, ServiceNow, Power BI and workflow or automation platforms where available.
· Identify repetitive Service Management activities suitable for automation.
· Build or support practical analytics, dashboards, workflows and AI-enabled use cases.
· Apply human oversight and appropriate guardrails when using AI or automation in operational processes.
Engineering and Observability Collaboration
· Work with Cloud, Infrastructure, Application, Platform and Engineering teams.
· Develop a practical understanding of monitoring, events, logs, metrics and traces.
· Connect technical operational information with Service Management records and processes.
· Identify existing engineering tools, scripts or automation that can be reused for Service Management improvement.
Continuous Improvement and Adoption
· Maintain an improvement backlog with defined owners, outcomes and progress.
· Document opportunities, implementation decisions, benefits and lessons learned.
· Share reusable methods and solutions across client accounts.
· Coach practitioners in adopting improved ways of working within assigned initiatives.
#LI-RB1
You will be successful in this role if you have:
Experience and Skills
Must Have
· Approximately 5-8 years of relevant IT Operations or Service Management experience.
· Practical experience in at least two areas such as Incident/Major Incident, Problem, Change, Configuration or Continual Improvement.
· Evidence of improving a process or service, not only operating an established process.
· Strong analytical, facilitation and problem-solving capability.
· Ability to work independently with technical resolver groups and multiple stakeholders.
· Curiosity, adaptability and willingness to learn unfamiliar tools or technologies.
Should Have
· Exposure to ServiceNow, Jira or comparable ITSM platforms.
· Exposure to Cloud, DevOps, CI/CD, monitoring or observability concepts.
· Experience with Power BI, Microsoft Copilot, Claude, Power Automate or equivalent technologies.
· Working understanding of ITIL practices and their practical application.
Good to Have
· SRE concepts and reliability practices.
· ServiceNow workflow or automation exposure.
· Cloud platform knowledge.
· Basic scripting, API or workflow-development experience.
Success Measures
· Defined transformation initiatives delivered with measurable operational or client value.
· Reduction in repetitive effort, avoidable incidents or process cycle time.
· Improved use of technical and Service Management data for decisions.
· Sustained adoption of improved practices by operational teams.
· Reusable improvements applied beyond a single activity or account where appropriate.
Role Boundaries
This is not a traditional process-administration or reporting role. Deep software engineering expertise is not mandatory, but the individual must be able to work with engineers, understand operational concepts and convert opportunities into practical Service Management improvements.

Integrity: We act ethically and honestly.
Role Purpose
Lead the modernization and transformation of Service Management capabilities across client environments by challenging traditional operating models, identifying optimization opportunities, and implementing AI, automation, observability, and modern engineering practices.
This is not a traditional operational Service Management role. The individual acts as an internal consultant, transformation leader and change agent, responsible for redesigning how Service Management is delivered and demonstrating measurable business value through service stability, efficiency, automation and continuous improvement.
Key Responsibilities
Service Management Transformation
· Assess current practices across Incident, Major Incident, Problem, Change, Asset, Configuration and related Service Management capabilities.
· Challenge legacy processes and identify opportunities to simplify, automate and modernize.
· Develop and execute transformation roadmaps focused on efficiency, service quality and business outcomes.
· Lead continuous improvement initiatives across multiple client environments.
· Move Service Management beyond operational reporting toward measurable value creation.
AI and Automation Enablement
· Identify opportunities to leverage AI, workflow automation, scripting and low-code/no-code technologies.
· Partner with engineering teams to automate repetitive operational activities.
· Evaluate practical use cases using technologies such as Microsoft Copilot, Claude, ServiceNow workflows, Power Automate, RPA and other emerging technologies.
· Drive adoption of AI-assisted analytics and decision-support capabilities.
· Ensure appropriate human oversight and operational guardrails.
Modern Change Management
· Transform traditional CAB-centric operating models.
· Introduce risk-based and automation-driven change governance.
· Identify opportunities for automated change creation, auto-approval, standard changes and risk-based approval routing.

· Challenge existing ways of working constructively.
· Think like a consultant rather than a process administrator.
· Identify opportunities others may not immediately see.
· Connect Service Management with Cloud, Engineering and modern operations.
· Translate technology into practical operational outcomes.
· Work with minimal direction.
· Deliver visible transformation and measurable improvements.
· Help other team members adopt new approaches and capabilities.

This is not a traditional process-administration, reporting or single-process operational role. The individual is expected to work across Service Management and engineering domains, challenge established practices, define transformation approaches and lead implementation. Deep software engineering expertise is not mandatory, but the individual must be capable of understanding technical concepts and translating them into practical Service Management outcomes.

jobs.title: Knowledge Management - AI & Content Strategy Engineer
jobs.description:
What success looks like in this role:
The Knowledge Manager is responsible for shaping how ECS captures, creates, organizes, validates, presents, and sustains knowledge. The role combines knowledge and content strategy, information architecture, learning enablement, SharePoint fluency, and AI knowledge readiness. The objective is not simply to administer repositories, but to make trusted knowledge easy for employees, clients, and AI solutions to understand, access, and use.
This manager-level individual contributor will establish the frameworks and operating practices needed to turn fragmented documentation and institutional expertise into current, authoritative, audience-appropriate knowledge assets. The role will support internal ECS needs and reusable approaches that may be applied to client knowledge-management engagements, support experiences, and AI knowledge assistants.
The successful candidate will bring deep knowledge-management and content-creation expertise, strong information-organization instincts, and enough hands-on SharePoint experience to contribute immediately. Experience in learning and development is important because ECS needs to effectively connect knowledge capture with training, upskilling, workshops, and knowledge transfer. The role will work with technical teams on platform decisions, while retaining accountability for the knowledge framework, content quality, governance, and user experience.
Key Responsibilities
1. Knowledge Strategy, Architecture and Governance | 30%
· Design and maintain an ECS knowledge-management framework aligned to Endurance program principles, business priorities, and user needs.
· Define repository hierarchies, taxonomies, metadata, naming and smart-titling conventions, content types, source-authority rules, and audience segmentation.
· Establish governance for content creation, human validation, approval, publishing, access, periodic review, retention, archival, and disposition.
· Clarify decision rights and responsibilities for content owners, authors, reviewers, approvers, repository managers, and technical platform teams.
· Create scalable patterns that separate and appropriately connect shared Unisys knowledge, product-specific knowledge, client-owned content, and tailored client experiences.
· Serve as a hands-on SharePoint practitioner for knowledge design, while partnering with platform specialists for complex administration, engineering, integration, and security decisions.
2. Content Creation, Knowledge Capture and Curation | 25%
· Develop structured templates, toolkits, and guidance that enable subject matter experts and designated contributors to conduct interviews, workshops, documentation reviews, lessons learned, and knowledge-transfer sessions.
· Create and maintain templates, editorial standards, and authoring guidance that help content owners develop consistent playbooks, guides, reference materials, standard operating procedures, training content, and other reusable knowledge artifacts.
· Organize content so employees and clients can quickly understand it, navigate it, and apply it to their work.
· Operate staged content workflows that support intake, assessment, cleanup, smart titling, tagging, categorization, validation, publishing, and maintenance.
· Identify and remediate duplicate, obsolete, redundant, conflicting, orphaned, or poorly structured content.
· Improve the quality and consistency of how ECS presents technical and business knowledge internally and to clients.
3. AI Knowledge Readiness and Managed Knowledge Services | 25%
· Prepare trusted knowledge sources for Microsoft Copilot, AI knowledge assistants, RAG solutions, intelligent search, and multi-agent experiences.
· Establish AI-ready content standards covering structure, completeness, metadata, permissions, source authority, currency, validation, and intended audience.
· Partner with AI, engineering, UX, platform, security, and services teams to translate knowledge requirements into feasible solution designs without owning technical architecture decisions outside the role.
· Support knowledge assessments that determine whether source content is suitable for AI ingestion and identify cleanup or remediation required before implementation.
· Design reusable managed-knowledge practices covering content creation, validation, governance, maintenance, and service metrics.
· Create feedback loops that connect user experience and AI response quality to source-content remediation and knowledge-gap closure.
4. Learning Enablement and Adoption | 15%
· Help apply learning-and-development principles to convert captured knowledge into role-based learning paths, workshops, job aids, and onboarding materials.
· Partner with Endurance program leads, practice teams, and learning resources to support concurrent training and knowledge-transfer activities.
· Build repeatable enablement patterns that can be piloted in one product or practice and adapted for subsequent areas.
· Develop guidance and communications that help contributors create better content and help users find and apply authoritative knowledge.
· Promote sustainable knowledge-sharing behaviors and support practices in taking operational ownership of their knowledge.
5. Metrics, Reporting and Continuous Improvement | 5%
· Define indicators for content quality, validation status, freshness, coverage, discoverability, reuse, adoption, learning effectiveness, and AI readiness.
· Provide concise reporting on repository health, knowledge gaps, governance compliance, risks, remediation priorities, and business outcomes.
· Use analytics, search behavior, feedback, and AI-quality observations to maintain a prioritized improvement backlog.
#LI-ND1
You will be successful in this role if you have:
Required Skills:
· Bachelor's degree in Knowledge Management, Library or Information Science, Instructional Design, Information Systems, Communications, Business, or a related field.
· Min 2 years of experience across knowledge management, content strategy, information architecture, content operations, organizational learning, or a related discipline.
· Demonstrated ability to design taxonomies, metadata models, repository hierarchies, content standards, and lifecycle-governance practices.
· Hands-on experience with SharePoint, including hubs, sites, libraries, content types, metadata, permissions, navigation, and search.
· Experience capturing expert knowledge and converting it into accessible, reusable content for different audiences.
· Experience leading cross-functional work with business, technical, learning, and governance stakeholders in a globally distributed environment.
· Strong writing, editing, facilitation, synthesis, and visual-communication skills.
· Demonstrated ability to operate as a hands-on manager-level individual contributor, set frameworks, and influence without direct authority.
· Experience supporting Microsoft Copilot, AI knowledge assistants, enterprise search, agentic solutions, or RAG-based implementations.
Preferred Qualifications
· Background in learning and development, instructional design, curriculum development, technical training, or workforce enablement.
· Familiarity with content ingestion, semantic retrieval, vector search, knowledge graphs, web crawling, automated tagging, or content-quality automation.
· Experience assessing and organizing technical product, support, engineering, or client documentation.
· Experience shaping managed knowledge services or professional-services offerings.
· Relevant certification in knowledge management, library science, learning, SharePoint, Microsoft 365, records management, or information governance.

UPI is the backbone of India's digital payments revolution — and Paytm is one of its largest participants, processing hundreds of millions of transactions every month. We are looking for a Product Manager to join our UPI team and drive product strategy, user growth, and experience excellence across our UPI-powered flows.
This role sits at the intersection of consumer behaviour, financial infrastructure, and regulatory nuance. You will own high-impact product surfaces and work closely with engineering, design, data, and business teams to ship products that millions of Indians use daily.

- Own the end-to-end analytics charter for one or more UPI surfaces — from metric definition to instrumentation to insight generation

jobs.description:
About Paytm

Paytm is a pioneer of digital payments in India, serving over 450 million consumers and 45 million merchants across payments, financial services, and commerce. Over the years, Paytm has built deep in-house capabilities across technology, data, and operations to operate at scale with high reliability.
Paytm is building a full stack AI platform focussed on Inference and Agents, enabling large enterprises to deploy AI driven automation across sales, service, operations, and analytics.
The Inference and Agentic AI team operates as a cross functional unit spanning engineering, product, data science, business management, and sales, and owns the full lifecycle of AI solutions from opportunity discovery to deployment and scale.

Role Overview

Paytm is looking to hire an Enterprise GTM Lead to own the go to market charter for Paytm’s AI Inference and Agentic AI products across enterprise clients.
This is a managerial role that will lead business managers and client onboarding managers, and will work closely with enterprise sales teams to drive pipeline, deal conversion, onboarding, and client success.
The role sits at the center of Paytm’s enterprise AI charter and involves shaping GTM strategy, enabling sales teams, supporting client pitches, structuring commercials, and ensuring strong post sale execution.
The candidate will be responsible for building a repeatable enterprise sales motion for Paytm AI agents, including Pi Commerce and future AI products.
The role requires strong commercial judgment, enterprise stakeholder management, execution discipline, and ability to work across sales, product, technology, finance, and marketing teams.

Enterprise GTM Strategy and Business Ownership
Own the enterprise GTM strategy for Paytm AI agents across existing and new enterprise clients.
Build and execute sales enablement, pipeline generation, deal conversion, onboarding, and account expansion plans.
Work with leadership to define target segments, priority accounts, industry plays, and product positioning.
Translate business goals into clear GTM plans, sales motions, commercial models, and execution cadences.
Track the full enterprise funnel across sales channels and drive corrective action where performance deviates from plan.

Accompany sales teams in key client pitches, discovery discussions, solutioning sessions, and commercial negotiations.
Build reusable sales assets including pitch decks, case studies, proposals, demo scripts, pricing notes, and competitive positioning.
Conduct regular training sessions for enterprise sales teams on Pi Commerce and other Paytm AI agents.

Commercial Strategy, Pricing, and Deal Support

Support custom pricing, proposal creation, margin analysis, and negotiation strategy for strategic enterprise deals.
Drive enterprise level invoicing discipline in coordination with finance operations and central finance teams.

Build client engagement programs to nurture warm accounts, enrich leads, and improve conversion from interest to qualified opportunities.

Set clear goals, review cadences, dashboards, and operating rhythms for the enterprise AI GTM charter.

Role Summary:
 The Area Sales Manager holds accountability for the health insurance sales performance of a ten-member Relationship Manager team in Delhi NCR. The role encompasses building the team, establishing and sustaining the daily field rhythm, coaching the sales pitch, and delivering the monthly premium target through open-market sourcing. 

This is a hands-on, field-based leadership role. The Area Sales Manager is expected to be present in the market alongside Relationship Managers — covering territories, participating in customer meetings, and supporting case closures with the team.

Own and deliver the team's monthly premium target. 
Drive login-to-issuance conversion by resolving documentation, medical scheduling, and underwriting pendency in coordination with the operations team. 
Conduct the daily morning huddle, spend structured time in the field with Relationship Managers, and audit lead quality to ensure MIS records accurately reflect field activity.

 Prior experience in a target-driven field sales environment within the direct sales channel of Health Insurance, Life Insurance, General Insurance, or BFSI.

Strong understanding of Delhi NCR markets, with the ability to operate across multiple locations and regions. 
Sound knowledge of health insurance products, including features, benefits, exclusions, and customer needs. 
An established local network and strong market connect across Delhi NCR. Ownership of a vehicle and willingness to undertake extensive daily field travel. 
Comfort operating within a highly field-oriented and target-driven environment.

Manager – Finance Controls & Governance
Role Purpose
To strengthen the Finance control environment by ensuring adherence to
approved SOPs, monitoring financial and system controls, overseeing
reconciliations, and driving timely resolution of exceptions. The role acts as the
first line of defense within Finance to ensure financial processes are accurate,
compliant, well-governed, and audit-ready.

Key Responsibilities
1. Financial Controls & Governance
Ensure adherence to approved Finance SOPs, policies, and internal control
frameworks.
Monitor key financial processes and identify control gaps and improvement
opportunities.
Conduct periodic control reviews and ensure timely implementation of
corrective actions.
Drive process standardization, automation, and continuous improvement
initiatives.

Oversee critical reconciliations, including bank, GL, settlement, and
suspense accounts.
Monitor ageing of unreconciled items and ensure timely closure of
exceptions.
Investigate recurring reconciliation breaks and recommend preventive
controls.
Publish periodic dashboards on reconciliation status and control exceptions.

Monitor SAP financial controls, master data governance, and accounting
configurations.
Review user access, Segregation of Duties (SoD), and maker-checker

reversals, and suspense accounts.
Participate in UAT for ERP enhancements and ensure financial controls
remain effective.

Track closure of Internal Audit, Statutory Audit, and Regulatory
observations.

Promote automation and technology-driven controls to reduce manual
interventions.

Working knowledge of SAP FI/CO (ECC or S/4HANA), financial systems, and

Financial Controls & Governance
Reconciliations & Exception Management
SAP/ERP Controls
Internal Controls & Risk Management
Process Improvement & Automation
Analytical & Problem-Solving Skills
Stakeholder Management
Strong Communication & Attention to Detail

100% adherence to Finance SOPs and control processes.
Timely completion of critical reconciliations and reduction in ageing items.

Closure of audit observations and control deficiencies within agreed
timelines.
Effective SAP access governance, SoD compliance, and system control
monitoring.
Reduction in manual processes through automation and enhanced system
controls.
Accurate and timely Finance Control MIS with zero material control failures.

You will own the campaigns that turn our merchant base into active borrowers. • Plan and run campaigns across push notifications, SMS, WhatsApp, email, in-app banners, IVR/outbound calling and the field sales force.
• Build merchant segments using transaction volumes, tenure, category, geography and eligibility, and tailor offers and messaging to each.
• Design and run A/B tests on creatives, copy, offer framing, timing and channel mix; scale what works and kill what doesn't.

• Coordinate with lending partners on offer constructs, approved bases and co-branded communication.
• Ensure every communication complies with RBI Digital Lending Guidelines, fair-practice codes and partner brand rules (KFS, APR disclosure, no misleading claims).
• Run festive and seasonal pushes (Diwali, wedding season, quarter-ends) when merchant working-capital needs peak.
• Report weekly on campaign performance and share learnings with leadership. Key metrics you will own
• Disbursal volume and count driven by campaigns
• Funnel conversion rates (offer view → application → disbursal)
• Cost per disbursal and campaign ROI
• Repeat / renewal borrowing rate

What we are looking for:
• 4–7 years in growth, lifecycle . Hands-on experience running CRM campaigns on tools such as CleverTap, MoEngage, WebEngage, Braze or Netcore.
• Comfort with data: you can write basic SQL or work fluently with dashboards and Excel to analyse campaign results.
• Strong grasp of experimentation: control groups, sample sizes, incrementality.
• Ability to manage many stakeholders and move fast in a high-ownership environment.

Displays Speed of Execution and adaptability in managing tight hiring schedules and candidate communication.
Strong focus on Candidate Experience and professional ethics.

enterprise systems.

automation. This role sits at the intersection of business process transformation, AI systems, and
enterprise sales.

opportunities, and design agentic solutions that deliver measurable outcomes such as cost reduction,

 Technical familiarity with APIs, system integrations, and complex enterprise software architectures.
 Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to bridge the gap and communicate effectively
with both technical engineers and business stakeholders.

metrics.

Utilize AI-driven productivity tools for automated documentation, meeting summaries, and multi-market status aggregation.
Implement AI tools for risk analysis, timeline forecasting, and dependency tracking across complex multi-team roadmaps.

Role Summary
The Senior Cyber Threat Intelligence Analyst serves as a senior member of the Cyber Threat Intelligence program and is responsible for independently collecting, analyzing, enriching, and disseminating actionable intelligence on emerging cyber threats, adversary activity, and evolving attack trends. This role transforms complex technical and strategic threat information into actionable insights that support security operations, incident response, vulnerability management, and enterprise risk decisions.
The ideal candidate possesses deep expertise in cyber threat intelligence tradecraft, threat actor tracking, infrastructure analysis, and intelligence production. They operate with minimal supervision, lead complex intelligence investigations, provide authoritative threat assessments, and serve as a trusted advisor to technical teams and leadership. NXP is a global player in Semiconductor industry, and security is an essential and integral part of our business.

Monitor and assess emerging cyber threats, adversary activity, malware campaigns, and vulnerability exploitation trends.
Track threat actors and analyze their capabilities, targeting, infrastructure, and tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs).

Correlate intelligence from multiple sources and assess potential impact to the organization.

Develop and disseminate actionable threat advisories, intelligence reports, and emerging threat notifications.
Support intelligence-sharing efforts with internal stakeholders and trusted external partners.
Produce tactical, operational, and strategic intelligence products for technical and business audiences.
Deliver intelligence briefings to security teams, leadership, and other stakeholders.
Provide threat-informed recommendations that improve organizational awareness and preparedness.
Serve as a subject matter expert on adversary activity, emerging threats, and cyber risk trends.
Provide intelligence support during cybersecurity investigations and incident response activities.

Identify intelligence gaps, emerging risks, and opportunities to strengthen defensive capabilities.

Demonstrated experience tracking threat actors, malware campaigns, adversary infrastructure, and emerging cyber threats.
Experience producing tactical, operational, and strategic intelligence products for technical and executive audiences.
Proven ability to independently conduct investigations, develop actionable intelligence, and brief stakeholders.
Familiarity with nation-state actors, sophisticated cybercriminal groups, and supply chain threats.
Experience in intelligence-driven hunting to identify suspicious network activity and potential risks.

jobs.title: Senior System Software Engineer - Automotive
jobs.description:
We have an exciting opportunity for a talented Senior System Software Engineer to join our dynamic Automotive Team and help us develop innovative, secure, and high-performance automotive systems. If you have a good understanding of operating systems and computer architecture, experience in device driver development and performance tools, and strong C/C++ or Ada/SPARK programming skills, we want to hear from you! Join us in creating the future of automotive technology and be part of a team that is revolutionizing the industry.
We are a leading artificial intelligence computing company and are paving the way with innovations in gaming, visualization, supercomputing, and self-driving cars. NVIDIA gives automakers, tier-1 suppliers, automotive research institutions, and start-ups the power and flexibility to develop and deploy breakthrough artificial intelligence systems for self-driving vehicles. Our unified computing architecture makes it possible to train deep neural networks in the data center on the NVIDIA DGX™, and then seamlessly run them on NVIDIA's DRIVE platform inside the vehicle. Leading vehicle manufacturers, tier 1 suppliers, mapping and simulation companies, software and sensor providers, and startups around the world are developing on the NVIDIA DRIVE® platform to deliver the best solutions for the new world of mobility. As a Senior System Software Engineer in the Automotive team, you will get an opportunity to work on Nvidia's latest SOCs, help tackle complex and important problems, and work alongside industry experts in diverse teams and projects.
What you’ll be doing:
Design and develop safety (ISO26262) and security (ISO21434) compliant system software for NVIDIA DRIVE platform for autonomous vehicles
Design simple and creative solutions for complex system problems, by decomposing the problem into smaller problems.
Design Real Time System Software solutions for NVIDIA Tegra SOC
Perform development & bring-up activities for next-generation Tegra SOC hardware
Work with the ASIC teams to enhance virtualization support in the SOC
Design debugging solutions and tooling to improve developer experience on DRIVE platform
Learn to harness maximum and consistent system software performance and develop workflows and tools to measure performance
Handle complex issues requiring interactions between components partitioned across the large software stack
Extensively use Formal Methods to develop high integrity software, benefiting from enhanced toolchain automation.
What we need to see:
Bachelors/Masters or equivalent experience in Computer Science from a reputable engineering college
8+ years of experience in System Software development on real time embedded systems
Strong understanding of computer architecture and operating system fundamentals
Strong C/C++ and/or Ada/SPARK programming and debugging skills
Hands-on experience with debugging tools like gdb, valgrind
A dedicated, action-oriented, strong teammate, who’s self-motivated with excellent analytical and interpersonal skills
Ways to stand out from the crowd:
In-depth knowledge of embedded systems and real time operating systems, like QNX and RT Linux skills
Good understanding of ARM architecture and writing low level software for ARM v8 based SOCs
Experience in taking features from inception to the product following Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) practices
Hands-on experience with performance analysis tools, such as gprof, perf, system analyzer tools
Hands-on experience with formal methods, especially using TLA+ and Ada/SPARK toolchains as well as strong familiarity with PCI, and PCI based endpoint drivers including eg. NVME storage.
With competitive salaries and a generous benefits package, NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most talented people in the world working for us. Do you want to be one of them? If you're creative and self driven, we want to hear from you! We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

jobs.title: Subsea Sales Engineering Director
jobs.description:
At Nokia, we create technology that helps the world act together. As part of our Optical Networks business, the Subsea team is enabling the next generation of global connectivity—supporting cloud-scale growth, open cable systems, and mission‑critical international networks.
We are looking for a Systems Engineer to join our Subsea team, based in India working closely with subsea operators across the region. This is a senior, customer‑facing role combining deep technical expertise with commercial awareness, supporting pre‑sales, solution design, and long‑term customer partnerships.
You will work alongside Account Management, Sales, Product Management, and R&D to design and position end‑to‑end subsea optical solutions, while feeding real customer insight back into Nokia’s product and technology roadmap.
Act as the lead technical authority for Nokia’s subsea optical solutions across India, with a strong focus on large-scale subsea operators
Provide pre‑sales technical support, including solution architecture, network design, bills of material, and technical proposals
Engage directly with customers to analyse network requirements, use cases, and growth plans, and translate these into robust, scalable solutions
Design and present subsea transmission solutions, including SLTE, open line systems, and related optical transport technologies
Support RFP/RFQ responses, technical clarifications, and customer workshops
Partner with Sales and Project teams through the full lifecycle—from opportunity qualification to contract closure and early delivery phases
Act as a trusted technical advisor for customers, developing long‑term relationships built on credibility and insight
Provide structured customer and market feedback to Product Management, influencing future features, architectures, and roadmaps
Contribute to technical marketing activities such as whitepapers, solution positioning, and conference or customer presentations
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Telecommunications, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or equivalent technical discipline
Strong hands‑on experience in submarine optical networks, including SLTE and subsea system design
Solid understanding of optical networking technologies (DWDM, ROADM, OTN); knowledge of IP/Ethernet and data‑center connectivity is an advantage
Experience working directly with large-scale international network operators
Proven background in technical pre‑sales, solutions architecture, or systems engineering roles
Experience responding to RFPs/RFQs and building technical/commercial proposals
Excellent presentation, communication, and stakeholder‑management skills
Comfortable operating independently in a senior, customer‑facing role
Fluency in English; additional regional languages are a plus
Willingness to travel across the India region as required

We are seeking a highly specialized Infrastructure Engineer Specialist to lead our infrastructure security efforts with a primary focus on WAF configuration management and building robust DevSecOps automation frameworks. Basic Requirements
Key Responsibilities
1. WAF Configuration & Lifecycle Management
Advanced WAF Engineering: Lead the lifecycle of WAF solutions, moving beyond deployment to advanced configuration management, including automated rule tuning, signature lifecycle management, and high-precision threat policy optimization to minimize false positives.
Automated Policy Enforcement: Develop and maintain automated workflows for translating business requirements into WAF traffic policies. Implement CI/CD pipelines that push WAF configurations as code, ensuring consistent policy application across environments.
Optimization & Tuning: Proactively analyze WAF logs to identify and remediate complex bot traffic and sophisticated attack patterns, ensuring high availability and optimal performance.

Security Automation Architecture: Design and deploy automated frameworks that integrate security controls directly into infrastructure provisioning. Use tools like Terraform or Ansible to enforce security baselines as part of the standard deployment lifecycle.

Pipeline Security Integration: Orchestrate the integration of automated security gates (SAST/SCA/Container Scanning) into CI/CD pipelines. Ensure that "Security as Code" is not just a concept, but an automated reality for all infrastructure deployments.
Policy as Code (PaC): Develop and manage automated policy engines (e.g., OPA, Sentinel) to programmatically reject non-compliant infrastructure changes before they reach production

Security Mindset: Deep understanding of automated threat mitigation, policy-as-code principles, and cloud-native security orchestration.
Hybrid Expertise: Proven ability to manage and automate security policies across complex hybrid or multi-cloud infrastructures (AWS, GCP, Azure).

jobs.description:
Company Overview
At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Department Overview
The Design & Tools (D&T) team is a strategic component of Centralized Managed Support Operations (CMSO), responsible for providing exceptional Service Design & innovative technology solutions to enable and empower MSI Centralized Managed Support Operations to meet and exceed customer's expectations.
Job Description
Position Overview
We are seeking a highly skilled and strategic Principal Observability & Event Management Engineer to champion enterprise-wide initiatives that improve monitoring effectiveness, reduce alert noise, and accelerate incident response.
In this dual-impact role, you will act as both a strategic leader and a hands-on technical expert. You will define the enterprise standards for multi-domain monitoring (infrastructure, cloud, application, network, batch, and mainframe) while actively designing and configuring our Event Management platforms—specifically Oracle Unified Assurance (Assure1) and IBM Netcool. The ideal candidate will leverage data insights, machine learning, and automation to transform massive "event storms" into high-fidelity, actionable signals.
Key Responsibilities
Strategic Leadership & Governance
Drive Enterprise Initiatives: Own and lead cross-functional, enterprise-wide initiatives focused on improving monitoring effectiveness, optimizing alert quality, and reducing incident volumes.
Define Standards: Establish corporate standards, approaches, and best practices for alert optimization across infrastructure, application, batch, network, and mainframe environments.
Culture & Mentorship: Mentor, guide, and evangelize a strong observability and optimization mindset across engineering and operations teams.
Continuous Improvement: Identify systemic gaps in monitoring design and lead long-term, architectural improvements to eliminate redundant or low-value alerts.
Platform Engineering & Administration
Infrastructure Design: Implement, maintain, and scale Oracle Assure1 / Unified Assurance servers and architectures for high-availability (HA) enterprise environments.
Event Correlation & Enrichment: Develop advanced Object-Server configurations, triggers, and correlation rules to distinguish isolated anomalies from critical root causes.
Multi-Vendor Integration: Integrate multi-vendor telemetry, logs, faults, and data from disparate monitoring domains into a single, unified Event Management UI.
Operations & Backend Support: Manage backend databases (e.g., MySQL, OpenSearch), maintain platform availability, and troubleshoot complex backend issues.
Automation, AIOps & Incident Response
Incident Automation: Write robust automation scripts and workflows to bridge monitoring tools with ITSM platforms (such as ServiceNow) to accelerate incident response times.
AIOps & Root Cause Analysis (RCA): Apply Machine Learning (ML) algorithms, topological discovery, and data-driven approaches to enhance event correlation, suppress noise, and automate self-healing or ticket generation.
Basic Requirements
Required Qualifications & Skills

jobs.description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.
Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.
1. OPEX Budgeting (Annual & Quarterly)
Lead preparation of the annual OPEX budget for Construction & Facilities, covering utilities, O&M contracts, AMCs, repairs and maintenance, consumables, services, manpower contracts and other operating cost elements.
Prepare quarterly budget refreshes and rolling forecasts; incorporate operational changes, ramp-up plans, contract renewals, escalations and inflation assumptions.
Build cost models and bottom-up estimates with cost owners; maintain clear basis-of-estimate documentation and assumptions.
Align budgets to cost centers, GL accounts and WBS elements as per Micron Finance structure; support budget reviews and approvals with the Program Lead and Finance.
Identify cost-saving and cost-avoidance opportunities and incorporate them into budget plans.
2. OPEX QVS Performance Tracking
Track and report OPEX performance against QVS targets on a monthly and quarterly basis, including actuals, commitments, accruals and forecast-to-complete.
Perform variance analysis (budget vs. actual vs. forecast), identify root causes and drive corrective actions with cost owners.
Prepare dashboards and management reports for the Program Lead and site leadership; highlight risks, opportunities and spend trends.
Support month-end and quarter-end close, and respond to Finance and corporate queries on OPEX performance.
3. SAP Transactions – PR Issuance, GRN Adjustments & Accruals
Create, modify and track Purchase Requisitions (PRs) in SAP with correct account assignment (cost center, GL, WBS), and follow up through approval workflow to PO conversion.
Coordinate Goods/Service Receipts (GRN/SES) with requestors and perform GRN adjustments, reversals and corrections as required.
Estimate and post monthly accruals for services rendered but not invoiced; reverse and true-up accruals in line with corporate accounting policies and close calendars.
Monitor open POs, aged commitments and unutilized balances; drive PO closure and de-obligation of residual values.
Ensure all SAP transactions are accurate, timely, auditable and compliant with internal controls (SOX / delegation of authority).
4. OPEX P2P Tracking (PR to Payment)
Own end-to-end tracking of the Procure-to-Pay cycle: PR → PO → GRN/SES → Invoice → Payment for all Construction & Facilities OPEX spend.
Validate vendor invoices against PO terms, contract rates, GRN/SES quantities and service evidence (3-way match); resolve price/quantity mismatches and blocked invoices.
Verify statutory requirements on invoices, including GST compliance, TDS applicability and e-invoicing details, in coordination with Accounts Payable and Tax teams.
Maintain a P2P tracker with status, ageing and bottlenecks; follow up with Procurement, AP and vendors to ensure on-time payment and minimize vendor escalations.
Reconcile vendor statements and support vendor ledger clean-up and resolution of disputes.
5. Governance, Compliance & Continuous Improvement
Ensure adherence to Micron procurement, finance and audit policies; support internal and external audits with complete documentation.
Standardize OPEX processes, templates and reporting; drive automation of trackers and dashboards (e.g., Power BI, Excel/VBA, SAP reports).
Partner with Procurement on contract scope, rate validation, escalation clauses and renewals to ensure commercial accuracy.
6. AI-Enabled Ways of Working
Use approved AI tools (e.g., Microsoft 365 Copilot, enterprise GenAI assistants) to speed up budget preparation, draft variance commentary, summarize contracts and SOWs, and prepare management reports, while checking all AI outputs for accuracy.
Use AI and advanced analytics for OPEX forecasting and spend trend analysis, such as predicting utility, maintenance and contract costs from historical consumption and operating data.
Apply AI and automation to P2P processes, including invoice data extraction, automated 3-way match exception flagging, duplicate or anomalous invoice detection, and accrual estimation support.
Find repetitive OPEX and SAP tasks that can be automated (AI agents, RPA, Power Automate, Power BI) and work with Finance, IT and digital teams to build and scale these solutions.
Keep financial data clean, structured and well governed so it can be used reliably by AI and analytics tools.
Follow Micron’s Responsible AI, data privacy, information security and confidentiality policies; never put confidential vendor, pricing or financial data into unapproved tools.
Share AI use cases and good practices with the Construction & Facilities team and support colleagues in adopting AI-enabled ways of working.

Title and Summary
Senior Software Integration Engineer(Quality Engineer)
Overview
The SME team is looking for a Senior Software Integration Engineer who can contribute independently in complex situations while supporting quality, engineering, and delivery goals. This role requires strong experience in agile work management, integration testing, quality assurance, requirements management, SDLC practices, systems integration, troubleshooting, web services, workflow management, and test automation.
The ideal candidate will plan, prioritize, and manage work using agile practices to enable iterative delivery, collaboration, adaptability, and continuous improvement. They will partner with developers and engineering teams to review source code, identify issues, improve quality, and promote maintainability and coding standards.
This position is responsible for designing, executing, and maintaining tests that validate interactions across integrated components, systems, services, APIs, data flows, interfaces, and dependencies. The candidate will help establish and maintain QA processes and standards that prevent defects, optimize performance, improve customer satisfaction, and support compliance.
The role also requires strong understanding of requirements management, SDLC, systems integration, web services, troubleshooting, and workflow management. The candidate should be a key contributor who can guide others informally and help teams deliver reliable, maintainable solutions.
Role
In this role, you will:
• Perform QE activities across assigned projects, including test planning, strategy, validation, automation, and release readiness.
• Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams to enhance testing processes and strengthen quality practices.
• Contribute to SME QE teams focused on test validation and automation within assigned projects.
• Design, execute, and maintain integration tests to validate interactions between systems, services, APIs, data flows, interfaces, and dependencies.
• Establish and maintain QA processes and standards that prevent defects, improve quality, optimize performance, and support customer expectations.
• Apply agile work management practices to plan, prioritize, and manage work effectively in iterative delivery environments.
• Partner with product owners, developers, and delivery teams to review requirements, clarify acceptance criteria, manage changes, identify risks, and ensure testability throughout the SDLC.
• Support SDLC activities including requirements, design, coding, testing, deployment, and maintenance to ensure solutions remain high quality and maintainable.
• Contribute to systems integration by validating communication, interoperability, and reliability across diverse technologies, processes, applications, and services.
• Implement and support UI, API, backend, and integration automation using tools such as Playwright, Cypress, and API automation frameworks.
• Support API performance testing and performance validation using tools such as Gatling and BlazeMeter.
• Troubleshoot complex issues across systems, applications, services, integrations, test environments, and networks using structured methods and tools.
• Evaluate source code written by developers to identify and address potential issues, support maintainability, improve quality, and ensure adherence to coding standards and best practices.
• Analyze workflows, identify bottlenecks, streamline procedures, monitor progress, allocate resources, and adapt processes to ensure work moves smoothly from one stage to the next.
• Contribute to CI/CD and DevOps practices by supporting automated test execution, version control, and integration of test automation into delivery pipelines.
• Provide technical guidance to team members, support proof-of-concepts, coach others informally, and help teams adopt scalable and maintainable test automation practices.
• Communicate status, risks, dependencies, and quality insights clearly to stakeholders and leadership.
• Promote agile ways of working, continuous learning, collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement across the team.
All About You / Experience
The ideal candidate for this position should have:
• Strong experience in quality engineering, test strategy, planning, automation, QA, and software validation across complex technology programs.

jobs.title: AI Principal Architect
jobs.description:
Our Purpose
Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.
Title and Summary
AI Principal Architect
Mastercard's Business & Market Insights (B&MI) group empowers organizations to achieve growth and innovation goals by delivering unparalleled data-driven intelligence and cutting-edge AI solutions. By harnessing proprietary data, frontier generative AI, and global expertise, B&MI helps businesses make smarter, faster, and more impactful decisions. We transform complex, multi-modal data into agentic systems and generative applications that drive measurable business outcomes and sustained competitive advantage.
We're looking for a Principal Architect, Generative AI & ML Engineering, for the Operational Intelligence Program within B&MI. As a principal-level technical leader, you'll define the architecture vision and technical strategy for our agentic AI platform. On this platform, agents make extensive tool calls into enterprise services and APIs and must run securely, reliably, and at scale. You'll set the standards teams build on across tool calling, multi-agent orchestration, self-correcting agents, memory, retrieval, and LLMOps. You'll also make the key decisions on models, platforms, and trade-offs. Working closely with engineering, product, security, and business leaders, you'll shape the long-term direction of Gen AI across B&MI and mentor architects and senior engineers. You'll also stay hands-on with prototypes that de-risk big bets. The hardest problems in enterprise Gen AI are reliability, integration, security, and scale. If you've solved them as a backend or distributed systems architect and have started applying that experience to LLM systems, we'd love to hear from you.
Roles & Responsibilities
• Own the architecture and technical roadmap for the Operational Intelligence Gen AI platform, defining reference architectures and standards that teams across the program can reuse and scale.
• Architect the enterprise tool-calling layer, setting standards for how internal services, data platforms, and external APIs are exposed to agents as tools. This covers schemas, contracts, versioning, access control, and resilient execution (parallel and chained calls, retries, timeouts, idempotency, circuit breakers, and fallbacks).
• Set the architecture for multi-agent and skills-based agent systems (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen), including when to use agents versus deterministic workflows and how agents coordinate, delegate, and share context.
• Design self-correcting agent patterns: tool critics and verifiers that check tool selection, arguments, and results, plus reflection and plan-and-execute loops that catch errors before agents act or respond.
• Architect agent memory and state for long-running, multi-step sessions, including short- and long-term memory (e.g., Mem0, Zep, LangGraph memory), session persistence, and memory scoping and retention.
• Define retrieval architecture for grounded reasoning, including Self-RAG, Corrective RAG (CRAG), adaptive retrieval, and Graph-RAG, built on vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, pgvector, OpenSearch) and knowledge graphs (e.g., Neo4j, AWS Neptune).
• Design the inference and orchestration layer for high throughput, covering async processing, streaming, caching, rate limiting, and model routing across OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, and open-source models.
• Establish the LLMOps architecture on Databricks (AWS), including MLflow, CI/CD for prompts and agents, and model lineage. Set platform-wide evaluation and observability standards: end-to-end tracing of tool calls, tool-selection accuracy, task success rates, cost, and latency.
• Build security and Responsible AI into the architecture, including guardrails, prompt-injection defenses, hallucination mitigation, data privacy, and audit trails that meet Mastercard's data ethics and regulatory standards.
• Own key architecture decisions and trade-offs, such as build versus buy, model and vendor selection, and cost versus latency versus accuracy, documented through architecture decision records. Assess emerging models, frameworks, and standards such as MCP for production readiness.
• Lead design reviews and partner with engineering, product, security, and data teams to align on architecture and raise the engineering bar across the program.
• Stay hands-on, building prototypes and reference implementations that de-risk decisions and give teams a working starting point.
All About You
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, AI/ML, or Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
• Significant experience architecting large-scale distributed systems in production, including microservices, event-driven systems, data platforms, and cloud-native infrastructure.
• Deep expertise in API design and systems integration, including contracts, security models, and reliability patterns for services consumed by many teams. You understand what changes when the consumer is an LLM.
• Hands-on experience designing and shipping LLM-powered systems in production, especially agents that use tool/function calling, memory, and retrieval, and a clear view of how they fail.
• Strong Python skills for hands-on prototyping (async programming, FastAPI or similar), plus SQL proficiency.
• Deep experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS preferred; Azure or GCP welcome), including its AI services such as Bedrock, SageMaker, Azure OpenAI, or Vertex AI.
• A solid grounding in security, privacy, and compliance for enterprise systems, ideally in financial services or another regulated industry.
• The ability to influence without authority, aligning engineering, product, and leadership around a technical direction and explaining trade-offs in business terms.
• Nice to have: hands-on experience with tool critics, Self-RAG, CRAG, reflection loops, memory frameworks such as Mem0 or Zep, MCP tool servers, or agent evaluation frameworks.
• Nice to have: exposure to fine-tuning (LoRA, PEFT, RLHF), multimodal models, or knowledge graphs.
• Coming from backend or distributed systems architecture? The hardest problems in enterprise Gen AI are reliability, integration, security, and scale, and you've solved them before. If you've started applying that experience to LLM systems, we want to hear from you, even if you haven't used every tool listed here.
Corporate Security Responsibility
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

jobs.title: IP RTL Senior Design Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Details:
Job Description:
The Role and Impact:
As an IP Logic Design Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in developing high-quality intellectual property (IP) for Unified Intel Chassis designs. This position is at the forefront of Intel's innovation, ensuring that our products consistently deliver world-class performance, power efficiency, and reliability. Work closely with architects to define and design complex protocol bridges. Define and implement range-based access control for secured memory and register paths across HBW and LBW. Own privilege qualification and policy propagation across AXI-Lite, APB, IOSF-SB, and HBW request paths. Design and validate parity/ECC generation and checking for request, response, and data channels. Define fault behavior for unauthorized accesses and corrupt transactions, including silent block semantics, RAZWI-style handling, poison propagation, and timeout cleanup. Build or integrate logging, interrupt, and firmware-visible error harvesting flows for local and global RAS handling. Support error injection, diagnostics, and post-silicon debug hooks for both security and reliability validation. Define and implement telemetry capture for fabric load, latency, congestion, error context, and other operational health indicators. Own debug and trace data paths for wrapper-level and fabric-level observability, including data capture, transport, formatting, and handoff to downstream debug infrastructure. Design counters, sticky status, snapshots, and firmware-visible CSRs that make performance and failure analysis practical. Integrate trigger, monitor, and logging hooks needed for bring-up, stress triage, and post-silicon correlation. Work with architecture, validation, firmware, and post-silicon teams to ensure telemetry and debug signals are useful, stable, and diagnosable. Balance observability depth against area, timing, bandwidth, and survivability constraints. Support root-cause analysis of bandwidth loss, latency outliers, protocol stalls, and intermittent field or lab issues using hardware observability features.
Key Responsibilities:
Develop logic designs, register transfer level (RTL) coding, and simulations required for IP blocks, functional units, and subsystems.
Define architecture and microarchitecture features for the IP block being designed.
Apply strategies, tools, and methods to optimize RTL design for power, performance, area, and timing targets.
Strong knowledge of AXI, AXI-Lite, APB, parity/ECC schemes, and transaction error handling.
Experience with secure MMIO, access-control/firewall logic, or privilege-based filtering.
Experience with RAS concepts such as fault containment, poison, interrupt generation, logging, and recovery-oriented design.
Support SoC customers with seamless integration and verification of IP blocks.
Telemetry and debug are both observability functions rather than primary Datapath functions.
Drive compliance with quality assurance standards to enable smooth IP handoff within the SoC development process.

Experience with industry-standard EDA tools for design and simulation (e.g., Synopsys, Cadence, Mentor Graphics).
Knowledge of IP block integration workflows within SoC designs.
Expertise in RAS/debug/security/telemetry.

jobs.description:
Job Details:
Job Description:
We are looking for a PERC Runset Development Engineer to develop and Validate PERC (Programmable Electrical Rule Checker) rule decks. The role involves working closely with PDK Team and foundry to implement PERC and ensure design compliance.
Key Responsibilities:
• Rule Development: Develop, validate, and maintain complex PERC rule decks to identify electrical reliability violations (e.g., ESD paths, current density, voltage stress, and floating gates).
• Multi-Tool Integration: Develop and optimize verification flows across multiple EDA environments, ensuring consistency in results between Calibre PERC( preferred), Cadence Pegasus, and Synopsys tools.
• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Device Physicists, Process Integration Engineers, and Analog Designers to translate reliability requirements into programmable rules.

Job Details:
Job Description:
The Role and Impact
We are seeking a skilled and motivated Layout Design Engineering Manager to lead a team of layout engineers in delivering best in class SRAM,RF,ROM,CAM Memory compiler designs across the Intel's bleeding FinFETs,GAA technologies. In this role, you will champion technical execution by overseeing compiler friendly and optimized floorplanning, high-density,performance based placement and routing template, and rigorous physical sign-off processes including DRC, LVS, Yield, DFM, Density, parasitic extraction, Noise Reliability i.e. EM, IR. You will provide technical guidance, set clear goals, and foster cross-functional collaboration with circuit design, Tilers, and foundry teams to meticulously optimize memory area, performance, power, and yield. Beyond daily execution, you will spearhead layout methodology innovations, establish advanced automation flows using SKILL, Python, or Tcl, and cultivate a culture of technical excellence by mentoring senior and staff-level engineers. The role requires a strong vision for leveraging AI and ML technologies (such as reinforcement learning for routing or predictive analytics for DRC debugging) to make execution significantly more efficient, robust, and high-quality.
Business group
The Intel Foundry group plays a pivotal role in enabling innovative semiconductor manufacturing solutions that power Intel's products and those of our partners worldwide. As part of the BA Memories organization, this position supports the development of advanced memory technologies and methodologies, empowering Intel's mission to shape the future of technology and create world-changing advancements.
Key Responsibilities
- Lead and mentor a team of layout design engineers to developed world class memory compiler designs on FinFets/GAA technologies, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and timelines.
- Oversee the design, development, modification, analysis, and verification of memory compiler layout designs.
- Provide technical guidance for analog, digital, memory, and standard cell layout methodologies, compilers, tools, and flows.
- Enable teams to execute effectively by setting clear objectives, maintaining accountability and facilitating productive workflows through AI-driven EDA tools and generative machine learning models into the design lifecycle to automate repetitive layout tasks, accelerate routing, and optimize cell placement.
- Drive team results by inspiring and developing team members, modeling Intel values, and fostering a supportive and collaborative environment.
- Manage resources effectively to optimize project execution and meet performance targets.
Qualifications:

- Candidates must possess a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics, Electrical, or VLSI Engineering paired with 15+ years of deep technical experience in memory compiler layout design and management.
- You must have a proven track record of successful tape-outs on cutting-edge foundry geometries (such as 3nm, 2nm, or below) using industry-standard EDA environments like Cadence Virtuoso, Siemens Calibre, and Synopsys IC Validator along with expert-level proficiency in driving layout methodologies and flows for analog, digital, memory, and standard cells.
- Demonstrated ability to lead teams and manage complex projects effectively.
- Demonstration of strong emotional intelligence, exceptional interpersonal communication, and an ability to lead, scaling high-performing engineering teams in a fast-paced semiconductor environment.

- Strong communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to collaborate across teams and disciplines.
- Experience in strategic decision-making and performance management for technical teams.
- A track record of fostering innovation and driving a culture of excellence.
- Passion for developing team members and maintaining a productive and inclusive work environment.
Join us in shaping the future of technology and take your leadership and technical expertise to the next level by driving meaningful innovation at Intel.
