jobs.title: Soft Skills Trainer – CRT
jobs.description:
Soft Skills Trainer – CRT
Description -
Job Description: Soft Skills Trainer – CRT
Location: Bangalore, India
Level: Intermediate
Function: Training Centre of Excellence (Training COE)
Program: Customer Resolution Training (CRT)
Role Overview
We are seeking a passionate and learner-focused Soft Skills Trainer to support the Customer Resolution Training (CRT) program, with a focus on strengthening customer-facing communication, service excellence, and effective resolution skills among customer support agents.
The ideal candidate will have experience delivering soft skills training in a customer service or contact centre environment and be confident in facilitating interactive learning sessions, conducting role-plays, providing individual coaching, and translating customer experience expectations into observable agent behaviours.
This is a hands-on training role that requires strong facilitation skills, a customer-first mindset, and the ability to collaborate with Training, Quality, and Operations teams to improve agent confidence, communication effectiveness, and customer resolution outcomes.
Key Responsibilities
1. CRT Soft Skills Training & Facilitation
Deliver structured soft skills training interventions aligned with CRT program objectives and customer experience expectations.
Facilitate interactive sessions on:
Customer-centric communication and active listening.
Empathy, rapport building, and acknowledging customer concerns.
Ownership, accountability, and end-to-end resolution.
Probing, questioning, and identifying customer needs.
Managing difficult conversations, objections, and escalations.
De-escalation techniques and emotional intelligence.
Clear explanations, expectation setting, and professional communication.
Positive language, call control, and effective closing.
Use role-plays, case studies, simulations, group activities, and real-world customer scenarios to reinforce learning.
Adapt facilitation methods to suit different learner profiles, experience levels, and capability gaps.
Reinforce the application of soft skills during customer interactions, rather than focusing solely on theoretical concepts.
2. Agent Coaching & Performance Improvement
Conduct individual and group coaching based on call observations, Quality feedback, assessment results, and identified skill gaps.
Review customer interaction examples to identify behavioural opportunities and recommend targeted interventions.
Provide actionable feedback on communication, empathy, listening, ownership, and resolution behaviours.
Conduct mock calls, practice conversations, and behavioural assessments to evaluate agent readiness.
Track coaching actions and conduct follow-up validations to ensure feedback is translated into improved performance.
Support agents who require additional intervention through structured improvement plans and targeted practice.
3. CRT Program Execution
Support the implementation and ongoing delivery of CRT learning interventions across relevant agent groups.
Partner with the CRT program team to understand learning objectives, customer pain points, performance trends, and priority capability gaps.
Prepare session plans, facilitator guides, participant activities, practice scenarios, and assessment materials.
Maintain training attendance, assessment results, coaching records, and program progress reports.
Ensure consistent delivery of approved content and alignment with CRT standards.
Incorporate feedback and emerging customer interaction trends into future training interventions.
4. Quality & Business Collaboration
Partner with Quality and Operations teams to identify recurring communication and customer experience gaps.
Participate in call calibrations and feedback discussions to understand performance expectations and align coaching approaches.
Analyse available quality insights, customer feedback, repeat contacts, and escalation trends to identify relevant learning needs.
Support pre- and post-training assessments to evaluate skill development and learning transfer.
Recommend targeted refreshers or coaching interventions based on observed performance gaps.
Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives aimed at improving customer experience and resolution effectiveness.
5. Learning Effectiveness & Reporting
Measure learning effectiveness through assessments, mock-call evaluations, facilitator observations, and post-training feedback.
Maintain accurate records of training delivery, learner progress, and follow-up coaching.
Prepare regular updates on training completion, learner performance, key behavioural gaps, and improvement opportunities.
Share insights and recommendations with the CRT program, Quality, and Operations stakeholders.
Demonstrate the impact of training through observable improvements in agent communication and customer interaction quality.
Qualifications & Experience
Bachelor’s degree in any discipline; relevant training certifications are an advantage.
Typically 3–6 years of experience in soft skills training, customer service training, communication coaching, or learning and development.
Experience in a customer support, BPO, contact centre, or customer experience environment is preferred.
Demonstrated ability to facilitate soft skills sessions and coach customer-facing employees.
Experience with call listening, mock-call assessments, Quality feedback, or behavioural coaching is desirable.
Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to influence and engage diverse audiences.
Proficiency in PowerPoint, Excel, and standard virtual training tools.
Ability to manage multiple training activities, maintain documentation, and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
Core Competencies
Facilitation excellence: Creates engaging, interactive, learner-centred sessions.
Customer empathy: Demonstrates a strong understanding of customer emotions, expectations, and service recovery.
Coaching effectiveness: Provides specific, constructive, behaviour-based feedback.
Communication: Communicates with clarity, confidence, and professionalism.
Adaptability: Adjusts delivery based on learner needs and performance gaps.
Analytical thinking: Uses call observations and Quality insights to identify capability needs.
Collaboration: Works effectively with Training, Quality, and Operations teams.
Execution discipline: Manages schedules, records, assessments, and follow-up actions consistently.
Success Measures
Training delivery completion and adherence to the CRT learning plan.
Improvement in soft skills assessment and mock-call scores.
Observable improvement in empathy, active listening, probing, ownership, and expectation setting.
Reduction in recurring behavioural gaps identified through call monitoring, where applicable.
Completion and effectiveness of targeted coaching and refresher interventions.
Positive stakeholder feedback and demonstrated application of learning on the job.
What We Are Looking For
We are looking for a practical, energetic, and learner-focused trainer who can connect with frontline agents, simplify behavioural concepts, and translate them into effective customer conversations.
The right candidate will combine strong facilitation and coaching skills with an understanding of contact centre realities. They should be comfortable working closely with Quality and Operations, using real customer scenarios to address capability gaps, and contributing to measurable improvements in the CRT program.
This is an intermediate-level opportunity for a trainer who is ready to take ownership of soft skills learning delivery and grow their impact through structured coaching, stakeholder collaboration, and continuous improvement.

jobs.title: Workplace Experience & Real Estate Portfolio Lead
jobs.description:
Workplace Experience & Real Estate Portfolio Lead
Description -
Workplace Experience & Real Estate Portfolio Lead
Bengaluru, India
About the Role
India is one of HP Inc.’s strategically important and operationally complex markets. The Principal, CREWS India is the accountable workplace experience and real estate leader for India, shaping environments that enable business performance, strengthen employee engagement, and help teams, peers, and partners thrive across multiple sites.
Based in Bengaluru and reporting to the Director, CREWS — APJ, the Principal, CREWS India will serve as a trusted country leader and partner to India business and site leaders, Finance, HR, Legal, Procurement, Security, EHS, and global CREWS stakeholders. The role requires executive presence, sound judgment, and the ability to align diverse stakeholders, lead enterprise-scale change, and translate business, workforce, and employee needs into an integrated India workplace strategy.
This is a strategic leadership and accountability role. The successful candidate will lead through others, influence without authority, and connect workplace decisions to HP’s business priorities. Success will be measured through business continuity, productivity and collaboration, employee experience, cost and capital discipline, risk and compliance, partner performance, and delivery of complex transformation priorities.
Key Responsibilities
Own workplace experience, facilities, and site services across India, creating safe, compliant, reliable environments that enable employees and teams to perform at their best.
Bring a hospitality-led mindset to workplace delivery, creating responsive, thoughtful, high-quality experiences for employees, leaders, visitors, and partners.
Set India’s real estate and workplace strategy, translating business and workforce priorities into portfolio plans, space optimization, investment choices, and executive-ready recommendations.
Partner with senior business and site leaders to anticipate growth, workforce, cultural, operational, and regulatory needs and convert them into workplace solutions that improve productivity, collaboration, talent experience, and resilience.
Establish strong governance through clear KPIs, SLAs, reporting rhythms, accountability, and recovery plans for service providers and internal delivery teams.
Own India operating and capital budgets, optimize total workplace cost, and build compelling business cases that balance financial return, employee experience, risk, and long-term value.
Provide strategic oversight of construction, fit-out, renovation, consolidation, expansion and facilities related issues
Build, coach, and develop India CREWS team and partner ecosystem, fostering an inclusive, positive environment where people take ownership, collaborate, and thrive.
Represent HP Inc. with landlords, developers, service partners, consultants, and senior governmental or regulatory representatives where required.
Drive EHS, security, procurement, financial, sustainability, and statutory compliance across the India portfolio.
Ensure disciplined follow-through on issues, escalations, and service gaps, with clear ownership, urgency, transparency, and closure.
Foster collaboration, ownership, continuous improvement, and One HP problem-solving across regional, global, and local teams.
Lead India’s employee transportation program, ensuring compliance, service reliability, and adoption of innovative, industry-standard technologies.
Education & Experience
Bachelor’s degree required in Business Administration, Engineering, Architecture, Real Estate, Facilities Management, or a related discipline; equivalent demonstrated experience will be considered.
Graduate degree, MBA, or postgraduate qualification preferred.
Typically 12+ years of progressive experience in facilities services, corporate real estate, workplace operations, portfolio management, or related fields.
Experience leading large, complex, multi-site operations in India, preferably within a multinational, technology, engineering, R&D, or shared-services environment.
Demonstrated track record of influencing senior executives, leading enterprise-scale change, and delivering measurable outcomes across workplace experience, cost, risk, and business performance.
Preferred certifications include Certified Facility Manager, PMP, RICS, MCR/CORENET, LEED, GRIHA, or equivalent credentials.
Required Knowledge & Skills
Facilities management, workplace services, preventive maintenance, EHS, sustainability, security coordination, and business continuity.
Construction, fit-out, renovation, HVAC, plumbing, property management, supplier management, and project governance.
Finance, procurement, financial analysis, budget ownership, forecasting, invoicing, and executive reporting.
KPIs, service provider governance, root-cause analysis, continuous improvement, and recovery planning.
Ability to navigate statutory requirements, government interfaces, landlord/developer relationships, and India market dynamics.
Leadership Competencies
Strategic thinking, results orientation, and the ability to convert ambiguity into clear priorities, decisions, and execution plans.
Executive presence and effective communication with senior leaders, employee councils, government representatives, landlords, developers, vendors, and internal teams.
Customer centricity, digital fluency, learning agility, and data-driven decision-making, with the ability to translate business, workforce, and employee needs into strategies that improve productivity, collaboration, engagement, and organizational performance.
Collaborative leadership across matrixed global, regional, and local teams, creating trust, shared accountability, and a positive environment where colleagues and partners can thrive.
Ability to influence outcomes without direct authority by building trust, aligning stakeholders, creating shared ownership, and following through on commitments.
Constructive, resilient leadership under pressure, maintaining clarity, inclusion, accountability, and momentum through ambiguity and escalation.
People leadership capability, including coaching, performance management, talent development, team building, and succession readiness.
Enterprise leadership potential to lead large cross-functional programs, influence long-term direction, and represent the function at senior forums.
Impact, Scope & Complexity
Shapes outcomes for large functions and leads complex, cross-division initiatives across India, with visibility and influence at country, regional, and global leadership levels.
Delivers innovative, practical solutions to complex real estate and workplace challenges, using data and stakeholder insight to improve employee experience, productivity, resilience, cost, and risk outcomes.
Balances day-to-day service reliability with long-term transformation, portfolio optimization, sustainability goals, and workforce experience outcomes.
Requires sound judgment, resilience, collaboration, and the ability to make trade-offs across cost, risk, service quality, compliance, employee experience, and business growth.
Preferred Leadership Differentiators
Experience with smart building technologies, workplace analytics, and sustainability frameworks such as LEED, GRIHA, or equivalent.
Track record leading workplace transformations or portfolio expansions in complex, high-growth organizations.
Natural ability to influence, align, and collaborate across global, regional, and local teams without relying on formal authority.
Passion for operational excellence and belief that the workplace can drive culture, performance, collaboration, and talent experience.
Travel
Travel within India and occasional regional travel may be required based on business, site, project, and stakeholder needs.
Why HP Inc. India
At HP Inc., CREWS creates workplace experiences that enable business outcomes, support our people, and advance the well-being of our communities and planet. This role offers the opportunity to shape one of HP’s most important country portfolios, lead through meaningful complexity, and strengthen India CREWS capability. The right candidate will help make HP’s workplace a competitive advantage while developing the breadth, judgment, and enterprise leadership capability to take on expanded scope as opportunities arise.
HP Inc. is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace.

Description -
Job Summary
HP’s Controls & Compliance Hub provides a unique opportunity to get a broad view of HP businesses and processes in a relatively short period of time. The team is tasked with assessing how HP management is managing the inherent risk in our large, diverse and rapidly changing company....a huge challenge!
This Expert role will be engaged to enhance, monitor, and provide ongoing assurance over the company’s business processes and controls. This position is critical for managements assessment of internal controls over financial reporting.
Responsibilities include but are not limited to the following:
Develops and oversees first and second line of defense for key mega processes.
Responsible for overseeing the design and implementation of control gaps and looks for ways to ensure the end-to-end suite of controls appropriately manages the key risks with robust processes while balancing efficiency
Drives ongoing evaluation of the control environment to review the efficiency and effectiveness of controls and ongoing improvements
Provides guidance on compliance matters and identifies hidden risks or non-conformity issues
Reviews the work of global control owners to identify compliance issues and provides advice, training and assistance with developing remediation plans
Partners with management, the internal audit function and external auditor as an independent team to facilitate successful control testing outcomes
Keeps abreast of regulatory developments within the company as well as evolving best practices in compliance and controls space
Drives adherence to regulations in all aspects and levels of business
Stays abreast of cross-functional/cross-organizational programs. Brings strategic insights in dealing with complex strategic issues.
Prepares reports for executive management and various stakeholders, as needed
Ensures timely and effective delivery of programs under scope
Understands implications of control failures, and helps to identify alternate controls and procedures
Education & Experience Recommended
Four-year or Graduate Degree in Business Administration, Finance, or any other related discipline or commensurate work experience or demonstrated competence.
Typically has 7-10 years of work experience, preferably in financial management, internal audit, accounting, or a related field.
Certified compliance professional certification (e.g. CPA, Chartered Accountant, etc) is a plus
Strong understanding of SOX processes, regulations, risk management and compliance frameworks
Content master in the field with a complete systematic knowledge of audit standards and accounting principles
Proven experience as controls leader or auditor. Advanced knowledge of the legal and regulatory environment as it relates to internal audit, including emerging legislation, auditing standards and accounting principles.
Knowledge and Skills:
Excellent communication, influence and presentation skills which can adapt to a wide variety of audiences
Superior understanding of end-to-end processes involved in supporting accounting and compliance principles; ability to provide compliance and finance consultation to senior leaders within area of expertise
Excellent knowledge of reporting procedures and record keeping along with business acumen partnered with a dedication to compliance and legality
An analytical mind able to “see” the complexities of procedures and regulations. Superior quantitative and qualitative analytical skills
Excellent project management, process design and prioritization skills, combined with diligence and attention to detail
Excellent interpersonal skills, including the ability to coordinate teams across geographies and functions
Strong leadership, consulting, influence, negotiation conflict resolution skills
Ability to apply management core competencies in working with both internal clients and external partnerships
Exceptional financial and business acumen; in-depth business and industry knowledge
Nice to Have that Will Set You Apart from Others:
Strong background in using RPA and AI and a passion for developing and driving cutting-edge solutions

jobs.description:
UIUX Design Lead
Description -
Job Summary
• This role is responsible for managing the overall user experience design strategy, ensuring it aligns with company objectives and user needs. The role leads teams of experienced designers in crafting digital user experiences that seamlessly blend visual design excellence, fluid interaction design, and functionality. The role drives design excellence and fosters a culture of creativity, innovation and collaboration, with a particular focus on elevating visual craft, motion design, and interaction fidelity across all touchpoints. The role provides visionary design direction, setting a high standard for user experience design, visual design, and usability. The role assigns projects, sets priorities, and ensures timely and high-quality deliverables.
Responsibilities
Develops a future vision that continuously balances the needs of the user, business objectives and requirements, and is also technically feasible, while demonstrating proper use of the organization's design system, including its visual language, motion principles, and interaction patterns.
Champions the development and evolution of visual design standards (typography, color, iconography, layout systems) and interaction/animation guidelines (transitions, micro-interactions, motion timing and easing) to ensure consistency across products.
Leads UX and visual design for Android-based devices — ensuring designs account for hardware, display/input variants, and software-hardware co-design tradeoffs.
Partners with engineering, design teams, and platform/software leads to align UX decisions across the product lifecycle, from concept through launch.
Creates user experience goals, priorities, and deliverables that align with product milestones, coordinates multiple projects to completion, and drives adoption of user experience, visual design, and motion/interaction design practices.
Partners with engineering to ensure animation and interaction specifications are feasible, performant, and faithfully implemented from prototype to production.

• Four-year or Graduate Degree in Design, Human Factors Engineering, Social Sciences research, or any other related discipline or commensurate work experience or demonstrated competence.
• Typically has 10+ years of job-related experience or 8-10 years of management experience, preferably in design principles, human factors engineering, social sciences research, or a related field.

jobs.title: Communications & People Engagement Lead
jobs.description:
Communications & People Engagement Lead
Description -
The Communications & People Engagement Lead is a strategic partner responsible for shaping organizational culture, driving employee engagement, strengthening leadership communications, and enabling successful change adoption across the Global Customer Care Centers (CCC) organization.
This role serves as the connective tissue between leadership, employees, and business priorities assuring that communication is not merely informational, but transformational. The individual will design and execute integrated communication, engagement, culture, recognition, and change management strategies that foster connection, transparency, inclusion, and organizational effectiveness across a globally distributed workforce.
The role requires a highly creative, customer-centric, and influential communications professional capable of translating business priorities into meaningful employee experiences that build trust, drive alignment, accelerate adoption of change, and strengthen employee commitment to organizational goals.
Working closely with Customer Care Center leadership, Operations, Quality, Training, HR, Communications, and other business stakeholders, the Communications & People Engagement Lead will help build a connected, resilient, engaged, and future-ready workforce while elevating employee experience across all care center locations.
Key Responsibilities
1. Strategic Communications
Organizational Communications Strategy
Develop and execute integrated communications strategies aligned to CCC business priorities, transformation initiatives, and organizational objectives.
Serve as the primary communications advisor to CCC leadership, shaping messaging that drives clarity, engagement, and alignment.
Build annual communication roadmaps and engagement calendars supporting strategic priorities.
Ensure consistent, timely, and effective communication across global teams, sites, and functions.
Establish communication standards, governance, and best practices across the organization.
Executive & Leadership Communications
Develop executive-level messaging, presentations, speeches, town halls, leadership updates, and employee communications.
Support leadership engagement sessions, all-employee meetings, fireside chats, podcasts, and interactive forums.
Partner with leaders to strengthen visibility, accessibility, and connection with employees.
Coach leaders on communication effectiveness, storytelling, and employee engagement approaches.
Communication Content Management
Own and manage end-to-end communication channels and content strategies.
Create and distribute:
Newsletters
Leadership updates
Internal campaigns
Employee stories
Organizational announcements
Transformation communications
Recognition communications
Ensuring content reflects organizational values, culture, and customer-focused priorities.
2. Storytelling, Branding & Employee Advocacy
Strategic Storytelling
Develop compelling narratives that connect employees to purpose, customers, business outcomes, and organizational strategy.
Translate complex business concepts into engaging, relatable, and actionable content.
Create storytelling frameworks that highlight innovation, customer impact, quality, transformation, and employee success.
Employee & Customer Impact Stories
Identify and amplify stories showcasing employee contributions, customer outcomes, operational excellence, and business impact.
Partner with leaders and teams to celebrate achievements and successes across geographies.
Build internal advocacy programs that increase employee pride and organizational connection.
Creative Content Development
Lead innovative communication approaches leveraging:
Visual storytelling
Infographics
Video communications
Digital campaigns
Podcasts
Interactive experiences
Executive narratives
Employee spotlights
Social and collaboration platforms
3. Employee Engagement & Culture
Employee Experience Strategy
Design and implement programs that strengthen employee engagement, belonging, motivation, and connection.
Partner with HR and leadership teams to improve employee experience across the employee lifecycle.
Develop initiatives that align employee sentiment with organizational goals and values.
Recognition & Appreciation Programs
Lead enterprise recognition strategies that celebrate performance, innovation, customer obsession, teamwork, and cultural excellence.
Establish scalable global recognition programs and engagement events.
Drive employee appreciation initiatives that reinforce desired organizational behaviors.
Inclusion, Belonging & Community
Champion an inclusive culture where all employees feel valued, respected, and empowered.
Build engagement initiatives that foster collaboration across countries, cultures, functions, and teams.
Partner with employee resource groups and community networks to create meaningful employee experiences.
Employee Listening Programs
Design and manage employee listening strategies including:
Pulse surveys
Focus groups
Listening sessions
Engagement assessments
Sentiment analysis
Translate employee feedback into actionable recommendations.
Ensure leadership accountability through continuous feedback loops and action planning.
4. Change Management & Organizational Adoption
Management of Change (MoC)
Lead communication and engagement workstreams supporting organizational transformation programs.
Develop comprehensive change communication strategies and adoption plans.
Ensure employees understand the rationale, benefits, risks, and impacts of transformation initiatives.
Change Communications
Create and implement communication plans covering:
Business rationale for change
Strategic objectives
Employee impacts
New ways of working
Adoption expectations
Success outcomes
Ongoing progress updates
Change Champion Network
Build and manage global networks of change champions.
Enable champions with training, messaging, communication assets, and engagement tools.
Drive local advocacy and adoption across regions and teams.
Adoption & Readiness Management
Measure awareness, readiness, engagement, and adoption of key initiatives.
Identify resistance points and engagement risks.
Develop mitigation strategies and targeted interventions.
Track organizational readiness and communication effectiveness.
5. Leadership Engagement & Organizational Effectiveness
Leadership Partnership
Act as a trusted advisor to senior leaders on employee engagement, communications, culture, and change initiatives.
Provide insights and recommendations that improve organizational effectiveness and employee connection.
Employee Engagement Events
Lead planning and execution of:
Global All Employee Meetings
Leadership forums
Town halls
Engagement weeks
Recognition ceremonies
Cultural celebrations
Volunteer and community activities
Learning and development events
Global Collaboration
Foster collaboration across sites, partners, suppliers, and functional organizations.
Encourage sharing of best practices, knowledge, and organizational success stories.
6. Employee Relations & Interpersonal Effectiveness
Employee Advocacy
Champion employee concerns, perspectives, and ideas.
Promote transparent communication and trust across the organization.
Active Listening & Empathy
Create environments where employees feel heard, respected, and supported.
Strengthen leadership understanding of employee needs and experiences.
Conflict Resolution & Engagement Support
Facilitate constructive dialogue and partnership across teams.
Support resolution of communication, engagement, and adoption challenges.
Promote collaboration and positive working relationships.
Success Measures
Performance will be measured through:
Communication Excellence
Employee awareness and understanding of organizational priorities.
Communication reach, engagement, and effectiveness.
Leadership communication satisfaction metrics.
Quality and timeliness of communication delivery.
Employee Engagement
Improvements in engagement and sentiment indicators.
Participation in engagement programs and activities.
Recognition program adoption and impact.
Employee advocacy and connection measures.
Change Adoption
Change readiness and adoption of metrics.
Effectiveness of change communication programs.
Champion network participation and influence.
Achievement of transformation communication objectives.
Culture & Leadership Impact
Improved employee trust and leadership connectivity.
Stronger culture of transparency, inclusion, and recognition.
Increased alignment to organizational vision and goals.
Enhanced employee experience outcomes.
Qualifications & Experience
Education
Bachelor’s degree in communications, Public Relations, Marketing, Human Resources, Organizational Development, Business Administration, Journalism, or related discipline.
Master's degree preferred.
Experience
8–12+ years of experience in Communications, Employee Engagement, Internal Communications, Organizational Development, Change Management, Human Resources, or related fields.
Experience supporting global and matrixed organizations.
Proven track record managing enterprise communication and engagement programs.
Experience supporting organizational transformation and change adoption initiatives.
Critical Skills & Competencies
Professional Skills
Executive and organizational communications
Internal communications strategy
Employee engagement and experience
Change management
Strategic storytelling
Event management
Stakeholder management
Program and project management
Communication analytics and insights
Content creation and digital communications
Leadership Competencies
Influencing without authority
Strategic thinking
Business acumen
Customer obsession
Relationship building
Emotional intelligence
Collaboration and partnership
Creativity and innovation
Resilience and adaptability
Inclusive leadership
Role Impact Statement
The Communications & People Engagement Lead transforms communication into a strategic business capability—connecting people to purpose, enabling organizational change, strengthening culture, elevating employee experience, and building a highly engaged, resilient, customer-obsessed workforce across the Global Customer Care Centers organization.

jobs.title: Knowledge Coordinator - Intermediate Document Control Support
jobs.description:
Knowledge Coordinator - Intermediate Document Control Support
Description -
The Knowledge Coordinator manages content feedback and documentation requests from intake through closure. This role combines request coordination, stakeholder communication, light content editing, workflow administration, and basic AI-assisted process improvement to help keep knowledge and support content accurate, useful, and current.
Applies intermediate subject-matter knowledge to resolve common business issues of moderate complexity. Works independently within defined practices and procedures, interprets established policies, analyzes information, and recommends appropriate actions. Contributes as an informed team member and may provide limited direction for small projects or workstreams.
Key Responsibilities
Manage knowledge feedback and content requests from intake through validation and closure, resolving straightforward updates or routing work to the appropriate owner.
Coordinate with content, product, support, translation, and technical teams to clarify requirements, track progress, and escalate delays or priority issues.
Perform light editing of knowledge articles, support documentation, metadata, process instructions, templates, and workflow content.
Maintain request workflows, ticket status, forms, and process documentation in Jira or similar tools.
Create, test, and refine basic AI prompts and low-complexity automations using approved tools and practices.
Verify completed updates for accuracy, clarity, consistency, and alignment with the original request and established standards.
Monitor request trends and operational metrics to identify recurring feedback, content gaps, and process improvements.
Tools and Platforms
Jira or comparable request-management platform
RWS/Tridion or a comparable content-management system
Power BI or similar reporting tools
CoPilot, ChatGPT, or other Generative AI tools and basic workflow-automation platforms
Education and Experience
Bachelor’s degree in Technical Communication, English, Communications, Information Management, Computer Science, or a related field; or equivalent practical experience.
Typically 2–4 years of experience in technical writing, content operations, knowledge management, documentation coordination, or a related field. An advanced degree may substitute for some experience.
Experience working with request-management, content-management, or workflow tools is preferred.
Preferred Certifications
• Certified Document Controller (CDC)
Knowledge & Skills
Knowledge and content request management
Technical writing and light copyediting
Technical and support documentation
Knowledge management and content lifecycle practices
Workflow coordination and ticket administration
Jira, content-management systems, and reporting tools
Basic prompt writing and AI-assisted content workflows
Low-complexity automation and process improvement
Quality review, attention to detail, and follow-through
Stakeholder communication and cross-functional collaboration
Data tracking, trend analysis, and operational reporting
Customer focus, digital fluency, learning agility, and results orientation
Impact & Scope
Supports the immediate team and adjacent stakeholders by keeping content requests organized, progressing, and completed to standard.
Improves the accuracy, consistency, and usability of knowledge and support content through timely coordination and low-complexity updates.
Complexity

About Analog Devices
Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. Job Description:
We are seeking a skilled and experienced DFT Engineer to join our VLSI design team. The ideal candidate should have a strong background in Design for Testability (DFT) techniques, including LBIST (Logic Built-In Self-Test), ATPG (Automatic Test Pattern Generation), DFT DRC (Design Rule Checking), MBIST (Memory Built-in Sefl-Test), Boundary Scan, JTAG and Analog/Phy DFT.
Responsibilities:
Collaborate with the Design/Arch/PTE/PD team to ensure efficient and effective testability of complex integrated circuits.
Design and implement DFT features such as scan chains, compression, and built-in self-test structures to enhance testability.
Conduct DFT DRC checks in RTL/Netlist database to ensure compliance with DFT guidelines and rules.
Utilize Siemen’s DFT tool to perform DFT analysis and optimize testability metrics.
Generating high quality manufacturing ATPG test patterns for stuck-at (SAF), transition fault (TDF) models using on-chip test compression techniques.
MBIST Design (including repair) and Verification using Siemen’s EDA tool.
Validation of DFT structures/patterns in RTL, Netlist with and without SDF.
Work closely with the verification team to define and implement DFT verification plans.
Work closely with physical design team for DFT implementation/constraints strategy for synthesis/STA.
Analyze and debug test failures and collaborate with the test engineering team to resolve issues.
Provide guidance and mentorship to junior DFT engineers.
Qualifications:
Bachelor's/Master's degree in Electrical/Electronic Engineering, or a related field.
7-10 years of hands-on experience in DFT methodologies and techniques.
Strong knowledge of LBIST, ATPG, DFT DRC, Scan compression, Low power DFT Techniques, MBIST, Boundary Scan, Analog DFT, JTAG Architecture, DFT STA Constraint development.
Hand-on experience/expertise in Cadence/Siemen’s DFT EDA tools for Scan stitching, DRC, ATPG, Coverage improvement, MBIST, Boundary Scan.
Proficiency in scripting languages such as Perl, Tcl, and/or Python for automation.
Solid understanding of digital design fundamentals, RTL coding, Lint/CDC, Low Power Checks and ASIC design flow.
Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to work effectively in a team-oriented environment.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

jobs.description:
About Analog Devices
Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www.analog.com and on LinkedIn and X.
Senior Design Verification Engineer
About the Role
As a Senior Design Verification Engineer at Analog Devices, you will lead verification planning and execution for next-generation automotive connectivity SoCs based on E2B technology. Working independently with minimal supervision, you will develop advanced verification environments for complex SoCs incorporating embedded microprocessors, communication subsystems, firmware, security functions, and mixed-signal components.
You will collaborate closely with architecture, digital design, analog design, firmware, functional safety, and validation teams to ensure robust verification coverage and high-quality silicon. You will also contribute to verification methodology improvements, mentor junior engineers, and help resolve complex hardware, firmware, and system-level issues.
This career-level position provides the opportunity to contribute to technologies that enable reliable, high-performance communication within modern vehicles.
Key Responsibilities
Verification Strategy: Develop and implement comprehensive verification strategies and test plans for automotive connectivity SoCs and E2B-related functionality.
SoC Verification: Verify complex SoCs containing embedded processors, memories, interconnects, DMA controllers, interrupts, communication interfaces, security features, and mixed-signal subsystems.
UVM Environment Development: Architect, develop, and maintain scalable SystemVerilog/UVM verification environments, including agents, scoreboards, reference models, sequences, assertions, and functional coverage.
Processor and Firmware Verification: Develop firmware-driven verification scenarios for microprocessor-based SoCs, including processor initialization, interrupts, exceptions, memory accesses, peripheral control, and hardware-software interactions.
C DPI Development: Develop and integrate C/SystemVerilog DPI components, software models, and reference models into simulation environments.
E2B Protocol Verification: Verify E2B protocol functionality, including data transfers, control and configuration mechanisms, timing behavior, error handling, diagnostics, and recovery scenarios.
Coverage and Verification Closure: Define and track functional coverage, code coverage, assertion coverage, test status, and verification metrics through sign-off.
Debug and Issue Resolution: Analyze and resolve complex issues across RTL, UVM environments, embedded software, C models, and system-level use cases.
Functional Safety Verification: Support verification of safety mechanisms, fault injection campaigns, requirements traceability, and verification activities associated with ISO 26262-compliant automotive products.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with architecture, design, firmware, functional safety, validation, and applications teams on verification planning, issue resolution, and product readiness.
Post-Silicon Support: Contribute to FPGA prototyping, silicon bring-up, post-silicon validation, and investigation of system or customer issues.
Technical Mentorship: Provide technical guidance to junior verification engineers and contribute to design and verification reviews.
Methodology and Automation: Improve verification productivity through reusable components, automation, regression infrastructure, and verification best practices.
Must-Have Skills
SystemVerilog and UVM: Expert-level knowledge of SystemVerilog and the Universal Verification Methodology, with experience developing reusable verification environments for complex digital designs.
SoC Verification: Strong experience verifying complex SoCs that include embedded microprocessors, memories, buses, peripherals, interrupts, and communication subsystems.
C DPI Development: Hands-on experience developing C/SystemVerilog DPI interfaces and integrating C models or reference models into verification environments.
Verification Planning: Proven ability to convert architecture, design, and product requirements into detailed verification plans, test scenarios, functional coverage, and sign-off criteria.
Coverage-Driven Verification: Strong experience with constrained-random verification, functional coverage, code coverage, and assertion-based verification.
Hardware-Software Integration: Experience developing firmware-driven tests and debugging interactions between embedded software and RTL.
Debugging Expertise: Strong analytical and debugging skills across SystemVerilog/UVM testbenches, RTL, embedded C code, and system-level environments.
Scripting and Automation: Proficiency in Python, TCL, Perl, shell scripting, or similar languages for regression management, result analysis, and workflow automation.
Communication and Collaboration: Ability to work effectively across architecture, design, firmware, functional safety, validation, and applications teams.
Technical Leadership: Ability to independently lead verification activities, conduct technical reviews, mentor less-experienced engineers, and influence verification methodology adoption.
Preferred Skills
Experience verifying SoCs incorporating RISC-V processors. Experience with ARM or other embedded processor architectures is also valuable.
Understanding of processor concepts such as privilege modes, exceptions, interrupts, memory protection, caches, debug infrastructure, and firmware boot sequences.
Experience with automotive communication technologies, in-vehicle networking, or E2B technology.
Experience verifying communication protocols, packet-based interfaces, control channels, diagnostics, and error-recovery mechanisms.
Knowledge of automotive functional safety development and ISO 26262 verification practices.
Experience with fault injection, safety-mechanism verification, requirements traceability, and functional safety evidence generation.
Experience with emulation, FPGA prototyping, virtual platforms, or pre-silicon firmware development.
Knowledge of formal verification, clock-domain crossing, reset-domain crossing, low-power verification, or gate-level simulation.
Experience working with analog behavioral models or mixed-signal verification environments.
Familiarity with automotive cybersecurity concepts and secure communication mechanisms.
Experience with continuous integration, regression automation, and verification dashboards.
Preferred Education and Experience
Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
Master’s degree preferred.
4–8 years of relevant digital or mixed-signal IC verification experience.
Experience verifying processor-based SoCs and delivering designs through verification closure.
Experience with automotive semiconductor products or communication SoCs is preferred.
Why You Will Love Working Here
At Analog Devices, you will be part of a collaborative and innovative team developing next-generation automotive connectivity solutions. You will work with experienced architects, designers, firmware developers, functional safety engineers, and validation teams to solve challenging system-level problems and deliver robust semiconductor products.
We offer an environment focused on professional growth, technical innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning. Your work will contribute to technologies that enable reliable, efficient, and high-performance communication inside the vehicles of the future.

Design Verification Engineer
Automotive Connectivity SoCs and E2B Technology
About the Role
As a Design Verification Engineer at Analog Devices, you will develop verification environments and execute verification activities for next-generation automotive connectivity SoCs based on E2B technology.
You will work on complex devices incorporating embedded processors, digital communication subsystems, firmware, security functions, and mixed-signal components. Working with moderate supervision, you will collaborate with design, architecture, firmware, functional safety, and validation teams to ensure that designs meet their functional, quality, and reliability requirements before tape-out.
You will contribute to SystemVerilog/UVM testbench development, C DPI integration, coverage analysis, regression execution, and debugging of hardware-software interactions. This position provides an opportunity to develop expertise in automotive SoC verification while contributing to technologies that enable reliable, high-performance in-vehicle connectivity.
Key Responsibilities
Verification Environment Development: Develop and maintain SystemVerilog/UVM verification environments, including agents, sequences, monitors, scoreboards, reference models, assertions, and functional coverage.
SoC Verification: Verify SoC functionality involving embedded processors, memories, interconnects, interrupts, DMA controllers, peripherals, communication interfaces, and mixed-signal subsystems.
Verification Planning: Contribute to verification plans by translating design and product requirements into test scenarios, coverage items, and verification objectives.
Test Development: Develop directed and constrained-random tests for block-level, subsystem-level, and SoC-level verification.
Processor-Based Verification: Develop and execute verification scenarios for microprocessor-based SoCs, including processor initialization, register accesses, interrupts, exceptions, boot sequences, and basic firmware interactions.

Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www.analog.com and on LinkedIn and X.
Senior Analog Design Engineer, Automotive Networking — Hyderabad, India
About the Role
The Automotive Networking Business Unit at Analog Devices, Inc. (ADI) is seeking a Senior Analog Design Engineer to join its Hyderabad design team. In this P3 role, you will design and develop high-performance analog and mixed-signal integrated circuits for wired automotive connectivity, including Ethernet and related technologies. Your work may span data converters, line drivers and receivers, clock generation, references, power distribution, signal conditioning, and input/output circuits.
Working with limited direction, you will own complex circuit blocks and contribute to product- and system-level design decisions. You will collaborate with experienced engineers and global cross-functional teams throughout the development cycle, from requirements and circuit implementation through tape-out, silicon validation, qualification, and production release. You will also have opportunities to review work and provide practical guidance to less experienced engineers.
Key Responsibilities
Circuit design and ownership: Design, implement, and deliver complex transistor-level analog or mixed-signal circuit blocks such as amplifiers, data converters, line drivers and receivers, references, clocking circuits, power-management functions, and analog interfaces.
Architecture contribution: Translate product and system requirements into block specifications and contribute to circuit architecture, performance budgeting, and implementation trade-offs.
Design and simulation: Develop circuit schematic and perform process-voltage-temperature, Monte Carlo, noise, stability, transient, and post-layout analyses; identify and resolve performance, reliability, and integration issues.
Layout collaboration: Work closely with layout engineers on floorplanning, matching, parasitics, isolation, signal integrity, electromigration, and other critical physical-design considerations; review extracted results and drive closure.
Product execution: Prepare assigned designs for review and tape-out, and support silicon bring-up, laboratory characterisation, debug, production test, qualification, yield improvement, and release activities.
Cross-functional collaboration: Work with systems, product definition, digital design, verification, layout, process, test, applications, quality, and manufacturing teams to meet product objectives.
Engineering trade-offs: Evaluate performance, power, area, cost, schedule, reliability, electromagnetic compatibility, and manufacturability trade-offs within the scope of assigned designs.
Technical contribution: Participate in design reviews, document design decisions and results, share best practices, and provide technical guidance to junior engineers when appropriate.
Required Qualifications and Experience
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related discipline.
Typically 5+ years of relevant experience in analog or mixed-signal integrated-circuit design.
Demonstrated ability to independently own complex analog or mixed-signal circuit blocks from specification and design through layout, verification, and tape-out support.
Strong knowledge of transistor-level analog design, CMOS device behaviour, feedback, noise, matching, variability, reliability, and circuit trade-offs.
Hands-on design experience in one or more relevant circuit areas, such as amplifiers, ADCs/DACs, line interfaces, references, regulators, clock-generation circuits, filters, or power-distribution functions.
Proficiency with industry-standard IC design and simulation tools, including Cadence Virtuoso and Spectre or equivalent.
Good understanding of analog layout techniques and the ability to collaborate effectively with layout engineers and review critical layout details.
Experience supporting an IC tape-out and subsequent silicon bring-up, laboratory measurement, debug, or simulation-to-silicon correlation.
Strong problem-solving, technical communication, documentation, and collaboration skills.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience with automotive Ethernet physical-layer circuits, wired automotive transceivers, or related high-speed communication architectures.
Experience applying automotive functional-safety, qualification, reliability, electromagnetic-compatibility, or electrostatic-discharge requirements to IC development.
Experience with behavioural modelling, mixed-signal verification, digitally assisted analog techniques, or system-level performance budgeting.
Evidence of technical innovation, reusable design methods, patents, publications, or successful silicon solutions is an advantage.
Why You’ll Love Working at ADI
At Analog Devices, you will join a collaborative, global engineering organisation solving complex problems at the intersection of the physical and digital worlds. This role offers the opportunity to influence next-generation automotive connectivity products, work with experienced technical teams, and help build a growing analog and mixed-signal design capability in Hyderabad.
ADI supports continuous learning, professional growth, collaboration, and meaningful technical impact. Join us to create semiconductor technologies that improve how people and systems connect, move, and operate.

jobs.description:

Senior Machine Learning Engineer (Growth & ML), Hyderabad
Meet our Team
Our Data & Audience Platform organization builds advanced AI/ML solutions that power identity, audience intelligence, advertising, and personalization at scale. Our Machine Learning Engineering team in Hyderabad develops foundational AI/ML capabilities that transform first-party data signals into production-ready machine learning systems. These solutions help expand addressable audiences, improve targeting and measurement, forecast demand, and personalize content discovery — driving advertising yield, marketing efficiency, user engagement, and retention.
Our Machine Learning Engineers combine strong data science expertise with hands-on engineering capabilities to take models from development to production. This includes building production-grade ML data pipelines, model training and optimization, and scalable ML infrastructure such as feature stores, training and serving pipelines, and MLOps frameworks.
We primarily leverage Databricks, along with Snowflake and AWS, and actively embrace emerging technologies, including agentic AI development workflows, to build reliable, scalable, and intelligent machine learning solutions.
About the Role
As a Senior MLE, you will own the design and delivery of production ML systems that directly impact audience targeting, advertising revenue, subscriber engagement, and retention across our global portfolio. You will lead technical execution on key workstreams — including probabilistic identity resolution, lookalike modeling, single-title affinity, and forecasting — while mentoring MLE 2s and collaborating closely with Staff MLEs and product stakeholders. This is a high-ownership role for engineers with roughly 5–8 years of experience who can independently drive a project from problem framing through production deployment and monitoring.
Roles & Responsibilities:
ML System Design & Ownership
Lead end-to-end development of production ML systems: data sourcing, feature engineering, model training, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring.
Own key ML products such as probabilistic identity resolution (matching unauthenticated device IDs and 1P cookies to households/persons with calibrated confidence), single-title affinity (e.g., STAT two-tower retrieval), and audience/propensity models.
Design scalable feature pipelines on Databricks (PySpark, Delta, Workflows/DLT, Unity Catalog) and the feature store, with documented feature contracts, backfill paths, and freshness SLAs.
Architect batch and near-real-time inference pipelines integrated with Snowflake and activation systems (Mosaic, FreeWheel, GAM).
Modeling & Experimentation
Develop and optimize models across the ML spectrum: gradient boosting (XGBoost/LightGBM), embedding/two-tower retrieval, neural ranking, probability calibration (e.g., isotonic regression), and probabilistic/graph-based matching.
Design rigorous offline and online experiments; define evaluation frameworks (precision/recall, AUC-ROC, NDCG, decile lift, calibration curves) appropriate to each use case.
Apply causal-inference techniques (propensity scoring, uplift/incrementality modeling) to measure true lift of audience targeting on engagement and retention KPIs.
Contribute to lookalike modeling (LAL 2.0+) using 1,000+ first- and third-party features, including privacy-safe builds inside Data Clean Rooms (Snowflake DCR).
MLOps & Infrastructure
Champion MLOps best practices: model versioning, champion/challenger promotion, automated retraining triggers, drift detection, and production monitoring with MLflow on Databricks.
Build and maintain robust, reproducible, auditable ML pipelines on Databricks (and AWS SageMaker where appropriate, e.g., the identity-resolution track); enforce leakage prevention and training/serving consistency.
Contribute to the team’s feature-store strategy — feature contracts, backfills, and freshness SLAs — and implement data-quality checks, model-health dashboards, and alerting thresholds.
Embed FinOps cost discipline (compute caps, auto-termination, job tagging) into pipeline design.
Mentorship & Cross-functional Collaboration
Mentor MLE 2s through code reviews, design discussions, and pairing; contribute to team technical standards.

jobs.title: AI Business Analyst – Applied & Agentic AI Systems
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
The Position
About the Role
At Roche Digital Technology (RDT), we are advancing the boundaries of Applied AI. As part of our strategic initiatives, we enable high-value AI solutions (with a strong focus on Generative AI and agentic systems) through fit-for-purpose platforms, services, and applications. The Applied AI Engineering Team is tasked with building innovative AI applications, GenAI agents, and agentic foundations.
In the 2026 tech landscape, the lines between traditional disciplines have blurred. We operate in small agile teams (typically ~9 members) powered by advanced coding agents (like Claude Code) to develop and ship solutions faster than ever before (Agentic SDLC).
To support our rapid-turnaround, high-velocity engineering teams, we are seeking a highly skilled, deeply experienced IT Business Analyst. Operating in a highly regulated pharmaceutical and clinical environment (GxP), you will serve as the strategic interface between complex business priorities, regulatory compliance frameworks, and cutting-edge engineering realities. You are not a traditional analyst who merely documents requests; you are a passionate, technically literate individual contributor equipped with advanced AI skills (including prompt engineering & modern agentic workflows) and the business acumen to collaborate closely with product leaders. Furthermore, you possess strong Product Owner (PO) skills and are fully prepared to confidently act as a Proxy PO for the squad if necessary—managing the product backlog, defining sprint goals, and steering delivery timelines to align with Roche’s strategic objectives.
Core Tech Stack & Scope
This role requires a deep understanding of three core domains: AI systems, the life sciences and pharmaceutical business context, and the complexities of operating within a highly regulated environment.
The IT Business Analyst serves as the strategic bridge between complex business requirements and cutting-edge technical execution. You will take ownership of the end-to-end requirements lifecycle for AI initiatives, ensuring that all architectural designs and engineering deliverables are scalable, high-performing, and strictly compliant with global regulatory standards. By aligning technical roadmaps with strategic priorities, you will drive the delivery of robust AI solutions that provide measurable business value and maintain the highest levels of data integrity and quality assurance.
Key Responsibilities
Agile Requirements & Product Owner Support (60% Focus):
Manage the full AI project lifecycle from opportunity identification through deployment and value realization.
Translate business goals into prioritized product backlogs, Epics, and User Stories with clear acceptance criteria.
Define MVP/MMR strategies to iteratively deliver business value while managing project risks.
Act as a Proxy PO when necessary, making critical decisions on prioritization and sprint goals.
LLM Prompt Engineering & Solution Prototyping:
Design and optimize LLM prompts to ensure accurate, secure, and relevant model outputs.
Prototype agentic workflows and evaluate model responses using Python scripting and SQL data exploration.
Develop specifications for dynamic Generative UI components and RAG pipeline context mappings.
Requirements Engineering & Business Process Analysis:
Lead requirements workshops and JAD sessions to elicit business and functional specifications.
Author standard-compliant artifacts including URS, FRS, and "as-is/to-be" process maps.
Conduct gap analyses and re-engineering assessments to optimize and automate manual workflows.
GxP Compliance, Computerized System Validation (CSV) & Software Assurance (CSA):
Guide compliance-by-design strategies for AI deployments following GAMP 5, 21 CFR Part 11, and Annex 11.
Guide risk-based CSA/CSV activities, authoring risk assessments (FMEA), trace matrices, and validation reports.
Enforce strict data integrity controls (ALCOA+) and system classifications to preserve validated states.
AI Governance, Risk Management & Observability Specifications:
Ensure governance guardrails, escalation triggers, and observability requirements for agentic AI systems are applied.
Assess AI-specific risks (drift, leakage, tool misuse) and formulate TCO/ROI business cases.
Change Control, ITSM & Configuration Management:
Manage formal Change Requests (RFC) and present impact analyses to CAB/ECAB boards.
Maintain system configuration documentation and audit-readiness for internal and regulatory inspections.
Audit Readiness & Operational Support:
Act as IT SME during audits, presenting validation evidence and requirements engineering practices.
Author SOPs, manuals, and training materials to support business readiness and operational transitions.
Practical Skills Required
Experience:
8+ years of IT Business Analysis experience supporting enterprise-scale software solutions, system integrations, and business processes.
5+ years of experience in highly regulated environments, with a strong preference for the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical devices, or clinical healthcare sectors.
3+ years of proven experience in Agile/Scrum product delivery, with demonstrated success managing product backlogs, writing detailed User Stories, and supporting agile ceremonies.
Hands-on AI/LLM Project Experience: Experience working directly on Generative AI or machine learning projects, supporting data preparation, prompt development, or AI application testing.
Proven track record of delivering computerized system validation or software assurance under industry-standard quality guidelines and electronic records regulations.
Demonstrated experience working with cross-functional, globally distributed engineering squads (including developers, architects, QA, and validation teams).
Agentic Workflow / aSDLC Experience: Proven experience leveraging AI productivity tools and writing/coding assistants (e.g., Claude Code, ChatGPT, Codex, GitHub Copilot) daily to accelerate elicitation, business process mapping, and requirements generation within an agentic software development lifecycle.
Skills
Must-have:
Advanced Requirements Lifecycle Mastery: Expert-level proficiency in elicitation, specification, modeling, verification, and traceability.
LLM Prompt Engineering & AI Prototyping: Proficient in designing, evaluating, and refining prompts for large language models. Ability to construct robust system prompts and templates that control model outputs and behavior.
Technical & Data Literacy (Analysis & Logical Assessment): Advanced ability to analyze complex data structures, logically assess AI model outputs, and trace data lineage. Strong technical aptitude to interpret technical specifications and evaluate system behaviors, with a focus on data-driven decision-making rather than hands-on coding or scripting.
Regulatory & Quality Expertise: Deep theoretical and practical knowledge of industry-standard regulatory and quality protocols, software validation and quality assurance standards, and global guidelines for electronic records and digital signatures.
Process Modeling & Visualization: Advanced skills in process mapping, business workflow design, and data flow diagramming using tools like Microsoft Visio, Lucidchart, or BPMN engines.
Business Case & Financial Analysis: Experience conducting financial analyses, cost-benefit modeling, and calculating the total cost of ownership for enterprise platforms.
Stakeholder Management & Facilitation: Outstanding active listening, communication, and negotiation skills, with the ability to build consensus across conflicting viewpoints, push back on unrealistic business requests, and translate between "business speak" and "tech speak."
Should-have
Agile Product Ownership Capability: Strong product thinking and backlog management capabilities using JIRA and Confluence. Ability to confidently step in as a Proxy PO when necessary to define MVPs, prioritize backlogs, and drive sprint goals.
AI/ML and Agentic Architecture Familiarity: Broad understanding of LLM architectures, RAG/GraphRAG concepts, multi-agent frameworks, and vector/graph databases to effectively analyze requirements for advanced AI projects.
IT Service Management (ITSM): Solid understanding of ITIL-based change management, incident management, and CMDB architectures.
Testing and QA Partnership: Experience partnering with QA to review test plans, coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and verify test coverage using Requirements Traceability Matrices.
Agentic SDLC: Strong drive to apply agentic Software Development Lifecycle practices and tools.
Could-have:
Professional Certifications: International Institute of Business Analysis (IIBA) credentials such as CBAP (Certified Business Analysis Professional) or CCBA; Project Management Institute (PMI-PBA) or Scrum Alliance (CSPO/PO) certifications.
Multicloud Awareness: Basic familiarity with cloud service models (AWS/Azure) and cloud-native application deployments.
Capabilities:
Problem-Solving Skills: Dissect complex, ambiguous, and abstract business challenges into manageable, structured, and verifiable functional requirements.
Ownership & Decisiveness: High-ownership mindset with the confidence to make tough priority decisions, remove development roadblocks, and step in to lead product direction as a Proxy PO when necessary.
Consulting & Trust: Ability to serve as a strategic, trusted advisor to senior business stakeholders, QA leads, and engineering teams, translating seamlessly between clinical business speak and technical developer speak.
Ethics & Empathy: Deep commitment to patient safety, product quality, data security, and ethical AI deployment, backed by a strong user-centric design approach.
Qualifications
The successful candidate should:
Have a strong understanding of both AI applications and traditional software development life cycle (SDLC) methodologies.
Be passionate about AI, staying up-to-date with emerging digital trends, software architectures, prompt engineering, and validation practices.
Be team-oriented, proactive, and collaborative, with a proven ability to thrive in a high-velocity, fluid, and multidisciplinary agile environment where roles are fluid.
Be detail-oriented, highly organized, and an exceptional problem-solver who takes initiative in identifying and solving problems.
Be willing to learn and expand their skill set in an environment where roles are fluid and multidisciplinary.
Be able to communicate in English at the level of: C1+.
Located in Hyderabad, India, with working hours structured to capture the "golden hours" of overlap with Central European Time (typically running through the IST evening).
Why Join Us?
Innovative Environment: Collaborate with a highly advanced, autonomous squad pioneering agentic AI and GenAI systems in healthcare.
Growth Opportunities: Bridge the gap between innovative technologies and critical, life-saving regulatory standards, expanding your skills into Product Ownership and Prompt Engineering.
Collaborative Culture: Be a part of a diverse and inclusive team that values technical excellence, strategic thinking, and creative leadership.
Shift: CET time zone

Software Engineering Best Practices: Robust automated testing (TDD) to verify both code written by AI agents and dynamic UI components generated at runtime.
Frontend & User Interface: Deep expertise in TypeScript and a major framework (React/Next.js or Angular 16+). Strong capability in complex state management and handling real-time data flow.

Building scalable, secure, resilient, and highly available systems.

jobs.description:

This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
The Position
External Job Ad Text
Job description
We are seeking a highly skilled AI Quality Engineer specializing in testing Generative (and non-Generative) AI applications and agentic systems to join our team. The ideal candidate will have expertise in both traditional software testing and specialized testing methodologies for Large Language Models (LLMs)-based and AI-based systems.
As a fullstack Quality Engineer within a lean, agentic software team, you will cover the entire spectrum of quality assurance. You will span manual exploratory testing, traditional automated UI/API/MCP testing (across our Python and TypeScript stack), classical machine learning validation, and cutting-edge generative and agentic AI evaluation. This role requires a deep understanding of LLM, agentic and ML systems behaviors, and testing frameworks to ensure the reliability, fairness, and effectiveness of our AI-powered solutions.
Description of the area
At Roche Digital Technology, we are advancing the boundaries of Applied AI. The Applied AI Engineering Team focuses on architecting, building, and operating high-value AI solutions and services to solve complex business challenges in healthcare.
In the 2026 tech landscape, we operate in small, highly autonomous agile teams (e.g., ~9 members) powered by advanced coding agents (like Claude Code) to develop and ship solutions faster than ever before. In this highly regulated environment, quality cannot be an afterthought. You will be the foundational pillar ensuring our rapidly developed agentic workflows and AI, GenAI, and agentic applications are safe, compliant, and robust before they reach the clinical or enterprise user.
Job Responsibilities
Generative & Agentic AI Testing Strategy: Design and implement comprehensive testing strategies specifically tailored for LLM-based applications and agentic systems, including evaluation of model responses, RAG pipelines accuracy, and overall system reliability. You will expand this to evaluate autonomous multi-agent behaviors and tool-use accuracy.
Full-Stack Test Automation: Design and implement automated testing solutions for continuous evaluation of LLM applications, including integration tests, performance tests, and specialized AI behavior tests. This spans both our Python backend services and modern TypeScript/React/Angular frontends.
Quality Assurance Framework & Compliance: Utilize Roche's testing frameworks that address both traditional software quality aspects and AI-specific concerns such as output consistency, contextual accuracy, and ethical compliance; co-create and maintain such frameworks when required. Create and maintain comprehensive test documentation testing strategy, test cases, and testing guidelines specific to AI applications and compliant with Roche practices.
Edge Case, Bias, and Fairness Testing: Identify and develop test scenarios for edge cases in LLM behavior, including handling of ambiguous inputs, potential biases, and unexpected response patterns. Design and execute tests to identify potential biases in model outputs and ensure fair treatment across different user groups and use cases.
Security & Performance Testing: Collaborate within development teams to test for potential vulnerabilities specific to LLM applications, including prompt injection, data leakage, and other AI-specific security concerns. Collaborate with other engineers to conduct thorough performance testing of GenAI applications, including response time analysis, load testing, and resource utilization monitoring.
Qualifications
Hold B.Sc., B.Eng., M.Sc., M.Eng. in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent degree with strong background in testing methodologies.
Be passionate about quality assurance and testing, particularly in the context of AI and GenAI applications and agents.
Have strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
Utilize critical thinking and problem-solving when using AI prompts (in e.g. NLP, data distributions and edge cases).
Be proactive in identifying potential issues and suggesting improvements.
Education / Experience
Experience: 7+ years of experience in software testing, with at least 1 year focused on genAI and/or agentic applications.
Regulated Environments: Be ready to work in a regulated environment with qualified infrastructure and validated applications, understand the difference between GxP and non-GxP products and the importance of CSV and ITSM processes in the delivery.
Agile Integration: Be experienced in working with Agile development teams.
Skills
Must-have:
Comprehensive Full-Stack Testing Mastery
Core Languages & Testing Frameworks: Advanced command of Python and standard testing frameworks (e.g., pytest, allure), alongside practical familiarity with specialized AI evaluation tools. High competence in TypeScript-driven test frameworks (such as Playwright, Jest, and Cypress) for thoroughly verifying dynamic generative user interfaces.
End-to-End Automation & CI/CD: Proven expertise in architecting and maintaining end-to-end automated testing suites that bridge traditional UI/API validation with complex, asynchronous AI/LLM evaluation pipelines.
Pipeline Integration: Hands-on experience integrating these comprehensive suites within GitHub Actions or modern CI/CD pipelines to ensure continuous, reliable quality checks throughout the entire development lifecycle.
Advanced AI Quality & Evaluation Mastery
AI Evaluation Frameworks: Expertise in implementing evaluation harnesses (e.g., RAGAS, DeepEval, Promptfoo) to quantify LLM performance, hallucination rates, and answer relevancy.
Agentic Workflow Validation: Ability to test autonomous agentic loops, including tool-use accuracy, step-by-step reasoning verification, and goal-directed performance metrics.
Evaluation Datasets: Experience in curating, managing, and versioning 'Golden Datasets' for benchmarking model responses against ground truth in both development and production environments.
Observability & Feedback Loops: Leveraging tracing (e.g., LangSmith, Arize Phoenix) to monitor production inputs/outputs, identify drift, and capture user feedback for continuous improvement.
Basic broad AI knowledge: Understanding of LLM architectures, RAG systems, agents, and common failure modes in AI applications.
Python Expertise: Advanced proficiency in writing robust, maintainable Python code for test automation (e.g., pytest). Experience using Python to orchestrate complex AI evaluation workflows, process large datasets for benchmarking, and automate interactions with LLM/AI services. Ability to integrate Python scripts into CI/CD pipelines for automated quality checks and performance observability in agentic systems.

Cloud: Practical experience with testing applications on cloud platforms (AWS) and working with cloud-based AI services.
Observability & ALM: Experience with monitoring and observability tools, log analysis, and performance metrics tracking (Grafana). Experienced in Roche mandatory ALM tools (Jira, GitHub).
Agentic SDLC & Engineering Excellence: Leverage AI coding assistants and autonomous agents (e.g., Claude Code, Ona) daily to accelerate full-stack development and testing cycles. Conduct rigorous code reviews for both human-written and AI-generated code.
Security: Understanding of security testing methodologies, particularly in the context of AI applications.

Regulatory Compliance: Proven understanding of AI quality assurance and testing standards within highly regulated industries.

Stay current with the latest developments in AI and GenAI testing methodologies and best practices.
Have excellent communication skills and the ability to clearly document findings and recommendations.
